characters.name: In General
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: In the anime. Justified since the majority of the Gold Saints were originally blondes. The anime gave a better color balance and made it easier to distinguish the Saints.Mu and Shion:Green-eyed blondes in the manga. In the anime, Mu has green eyes and purple hair (pink in earlier episodes) and Shion hasgreen hair and purple eyes.Aldebaran:Is a blonde in the manga. In the anime adaptation, his hair varies from dark brown to purple and since his back wasn't often visible, the length of his hair sometimes varies as well.Saga and Kanon:Both are blondes in the manga, and have blue hair in the anime. Later, the two are differentiated with Saga's hair still being blue while Kanon's is more teal. During hisSplit-Personality Takeover, Saga's hair becomes black; in the anime, it's grey and his eyes turn red.Deathmask:Has gray hair and red eyes in the manga. In the anime, he has blue hair and eyes.Aiolia:In the manga, has blonde hair. In the anime adaptation, Aiolia's hair color was modified to light brown to achieve a better color balance and contrast.Dohko:Black hair in the manga, but dark reddish-brown in the anime.Milo:Blonde hair in the manga. In the anime, Milo's hair color was modified to a blueish purple.Aiolos:He was blond in the manga, had brown hair in the anime.Shura:Black hair in the manga, dark green in the anime.Camus:A redhead in the manga, but the anime gave Camus blueish-green hair.Aphrodite:Was blonde in the manga, but the anime gave him light blue hair (blue-green hair in the Santuary Arc).Averted withShaka, who is the only blonde Gold Saint who is saved from hair dye, and becausehe always keeps his closed, it's not immediately obvious that he has green eyes in the manga. Therefore, Shaka still got an eye dye, so to speak, since his eyes are blue in the original TV series. Mu and Shion:Green-eyed blondes in the manga. In the anime, Mu has green eyes and purple hair (pink in earlier episodes) and Shion hasgreen hair and purple eyes. Aldeb

characters.name: Pegasus Seiya
characters.description: A spirited and tenacious Japanese young man, Seiya is an orphan who was forcibly separated from his sister Seika when first brought into Mitsumasa Kido's Graad Foundation. This estrangement becomes his main motivation for becoming a Saint, being sent to the Sanctuary at Greece, training under the Silver Saint, Eagle Marin. Having earned the Pegasus Cloth, Seiya is scouted by Kido's granddaughter Saori Kido, now leading the Graad Foundation, to work together to participate in the Galaxian Wars, under Saori's personal promise to find Seika. Distrustful of Saori due to herSpoiled Bratchildhood behavior towards him and the other orphans, Seiya reluctantly accepts, but gradually realizes that Saori's suspicions against the Sanctuary are true, and that his duty is to protect her from harm, finding out that she is the goddess Athena incarnate. Action Survivor: Considering the amount of danger he goes through in his mission to protect Athena, he qualifies by default. Animal Motifs: Pegasi, naturally. Blue Is Heroic: His cosmo aura is coloured blue, and he is the main hero of the series. Also in the Asgard arc, when donning Odin's armor (and sword) to destroy the Nibelung Ring and free Hilda from its control.

characters.name: Dragon Shiryu
characters.description: A Sino-Japanese Saint with a penchant for self-sacrifice, Shiryu is an individual with unparalleled determination who is not afraid to put life and limb on the line to deliver justice. Being one of the orphans housed by Mitsumasa Kido, Shiryu was sent to the Five Peaks of Rozan in order to gain the Dragon Cloth. He trained under the instruction of the old master, Libra Dohko, and lived as his ward alongside fellow orphan Shunrei, for whom he harbors a tender mutual affection. A Friend in Need: In one of the saddest moments of the serieshe blinded himself to defeat Perseus Algol and save his friends.Another memorable example would be Shiryu willing to bath Seiya's Cloth with most of his blood, aware that it would cost his life, in order to repair it. Without his Cloth, Seiya would not have stood a chance to survive the threat he was facing at the time and thus Shiryu was willing to offer his life for a friend in need. Ironically, he was doing this torepaySeiya for saving his life earlier. Another memorable example would be Shiryu willing to bath Seiya's Cloth with most of his blood, aware that it would cost his life, in order to repair it. Without his Cloth, Seiya would not have stood a chance to survive the threat he was facing at the time and thus Shiryu was willing to offer his life for a friend in need. Ironically, he was doing this torepaySeiya for saving his life earlier. Achilles' Heel: Shiryu tends to hold his guard over the part of his chest that coincides with claw of the dragon tattooed on his back, right over his heart. When he unleashes the "Rozan Shoryu Ha", his defense wide open for a fraction of a second - and if you hit him there, he's as good as dead. When Seiya points that out in the tournament, Shiryu freaks out.Subverted in that it's only used against him once more, by Capricorn Shura, but this time Shiryuhad been baiting him to land a killing move.It should also be noted that since the both of them are associated with dragons, he actuallyfigures

characters.name: Cygnus Hyoga
characters.description: Hailing from the icy thundra of Siberia, Hyoga is the pupil of Aquarius Camus (the Crystal Saint in the anime, a pupil of Camus himself). A rational and seemingly cold individual, Hyoga is actually a rather passionate and brave young man. Having lost his mother on a shipwreck that lays beneath the tundra, Hyoga's purpose with obtaining the Cygnus Cloth was to be able to break through the ice to visit his mother's icy resting place beneath. In the manga, Hyoga is initially sent to quell the rebellious Bronze Saints and Saori Kido by the Sanctuary, since they're seemingly using their status as Saints for their own purposes, but Hyoga ends up joining their cause. Adaptational Heroism: In the manga, Hyoga participates in the Galaxian Wars because he received an order from the Sanctuary to assassinate the other Bronze Saints. He originally accepted this due to his hatred for the Graad Foundation, being aware that Mitsumasa Kido was his father. Since the Saints are only Mitsumasa Kido's protegés in the anime, this sub-plot isn't there. Hyoga competes with the same motivation as the other bronze saints: to win the Gold Cloth of Sagittarius. Aesop Amnesia:Played for Dramain the Poseidon arc, when Hyoga's emotional attachment to Camus causes his defeat againstLyumnades. He reflects, with some shame, that he hasn't entirely conquered his emotions during battle — a lesson Camus himself attempted to teach him in the Sanctuary arc — and decides to consider the battle Camus' late reminder to cast aside his remaining sentiment. And as fate would have it, his next battle in Sea Sanctuary forces Hyoga tofight and killa former friend. An Ice Person: Hyoga is able to control and manipulate ice and snow as he pleases, as he mastered the basis of the technique of the Saints of ice, stopping the atoms of matter by the power of their cosmo.

characters.name: Andromeda Shun
characters.description: A gentle, kind, and delicately beautiful individual, Shun was initially supposed to be sent to the Death Queen Island to obtain the Phoenix Cloth, but his brother Ikki took his place instead. Shun was thus sent to Andromeda Island in order to obtain the eponymous cloth. Having obtained the cloth, Shun participates in Saori's Galactic Tournament in hopes of meeting his brother again. Though much to his dismay, when Ikki does eventually return, he has changed into a completely different person filled with hate who vows to kill Shun and anyone involved with the Graude foundation as revenge for what he's been put through for the past six years. AMartial Pacifistto the core, Shun will not engage in combat unles he's pushed to a corner, which, combined with his personality, leads to his opponents to underestimate how powerful he can be. Adaptation Dye-Job: A brunet in the manga, green-haired in the anime.Given aMythology Gagin Hades: Inferno whenShun became possessed by Hades. In the manga, it goes from brown (his canon manga color) to black only when Ikki failed to kill him. However in the anime, it immediately changed from Green to a bloody red tint to show Shun was partially possessed but didn't become black until after Ikki's attempt. Given aMythology Gagin Hades: Inferno whenShun became possessed by Hades. In the manga, it goes from brown (his canon manga color) to black only when Ikki failed to kill him. However in the anime, it immediately changed from Green to a bloody red tint to show Shun was partially possessed but didn't become black until after Ikki's attempt. Adaptational Wimp: In the anime filler episodes and especially in the non-canon movies, where his only role is to be defeated and allow his brother to save him time after time.

characters.name: Phoenix Ikki
characters.description: Alone wolfto the core, Ikki is an orphan and the older brother of Andromeda Shun. Having gone through a tremendous toll to keep his brother alive and healthy throughout their childhood, Ikki was brought under the tutelage of Mitsumasa Kido, where he has to intercede for the sake of his brother in order to save him from being sent to the Death Queen Island to obtain the Phoenix Cloth. At the hellish island, he befriended Esmeralda, a slave girl who reminded him of Shun. Ikki's master Guilty, a cruel and merciless individual, slays Esmeralda to force Ikki to gain the power to obtain the Phoenix Cloth. Having gone through so much trauma leads Ikki into a mysanthropic bout where he chooses to antagonize Saori Kido and the Bronze Saints by stealing the Sagittarius Gold Cloth. Ikki is thus the first antagonist in the series. Though Ikki eventually turns his life around, he chooses to remain alone and actively avoids the other Bronze Saints, only intervening whenever it's absolutely necessary, often coming to aid Shun in combat. A Kind of One: As part of aMythology Gag, contrary to his fellow Saints, Ikki is thefirst everbearer of the Phoenix Cloth, according to the Hypermyth. No other person before him had been awarded the cloth. Much like the mythologicalPhoenix bird, Ikki is literally one of a kind. The Ace: While Ikki is officially recognized as a Bronze Saint, his base power easily places him well above most Silver Saints, and his reputation as a powerhouse is common knowledge among his peers and fellow Bronze Saints. He could easily be recognized as the strongest Bronze Saint when it comes to raw power.

characters.name: Unicorn Jabu
characters.description: A young Saint who is shown to have been fiercely loyal to Saori from their childhood. An early rival to Seiya, he is overshadowed rather quickly in terms of power, though he remains a frequent presence at the Kido Manor and the Sanctuary. Adaptation Dye-Job: Actually had black hair in the manga, but the anime changes it to blond. Animal Motifs: Played with, as he has behavioral tendencies attributed to the mythologic unicorn, as he essentially was tamed by a virginal maiden in the form of Saori. Jabu is also hot-blooded and confrontational. Bodyguard Crush: On Saori, and way more explicit than Seiya too. Calling Your Attacks:Unicorn Gallop!: The user launches a hundred kicks on his opponent.

characters.name: Hydra Ichi
characters.description: Ascended Extra: In a video game, he's aFake Ultimate Herowith a big Ego. Demoted to Comic Relief: He is turned into a mere comic-relief character in Saint Seiya Omega. Dub Name Change/Meaningful Name: Renamed "Aspides" in Italian. Flat Character: Has no characterization. Gonk: He's gangly, pale (almost green), and has a droopy, almost ghoulish face with completely black eyes.

characters.name: Wolf Nachi
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Wolves. Curb-Stomp Battle: His only battle with another saint (Ikki) didn't last 5 seconds. Empty Shell: After Ikki'sMind Rapeattack, his soul was "destroyed" but somehow... he's perfectly fine when Saori needed protection at Sanctuary. Flat Character: Has no characterization. The Load: Widely considered the weakest of all the saints.

characters.name: Lionet Ban
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Lions. Can't Catch Up: In fact, he's the only Bronze Saint who was beaten in the Galaxian Wars byanotherminor Bronze Saint (Jabu). Flat Character: Has no characterization.Lampshadedin the manga, as he notices the first time he says something in the series.

characters.name: Bear Geki
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Bears. He is a big guy with bear like strength. Bears Are Bad News: He's arrogant and cruel in his fight against Seiya, and nearly breaks Seiya's neck in an inescapable grip. The Big Guy: The biggest of all Bronze saints. Crippling Overspecialization: He focused his training in strengthening his arms to the point he could easily throttlegrizzly bears. His arms werestrong, but break them and he is virtually defeated. Flat Character: Has no characterization.

characters.name: Chameleon June
characters.description: One of Athena's Amazons and a fellow student of Cepheus Albiore at Andromeda Island with Shun, Leda and Spica, June is a personal friend of Shun and a minor ally of the Bronze Saints.June is the only female Bronze Saint shown in the series, as well as the only one who was not a ward of Mitsumasa Kido, and thus not associated to the Graad Foundation. Aborted Arc: June deliberately removes her mask before Shun, with all the implications described below. And, because that was one of the last times she ever appeared in the series, whether Shun even acknowledged her, let alone her feelings, was left unresolved. Action Girl: She starts off by fighting Shun to keep him from leaving and, in the anime, in the flashback, confronted Milo when he first came to Andromeda Island, despite him being aGold Saint. Animal Motifs: Chameleon. Chickification: In the anime, one kick to the face later, she is reduced to aDamsel in Distress. It's evenworsein the manga.

characters.name: Eagle Marin
characters.description: A female Silver Saint, Marin is introduced as Seiya's teacher during his training to become a Saint. She reappears as part of the squadron of Silver Saints dispatched to kill the Bronze Saints, but remains an ally, guiding the group towards their mission of protecting Athena. Like Seiya, she is Japanese and looking for her missing sibling (in her case, her younger brother), leading him to question if Marin is really his long-lost sister Seika. Action Girl: She is the strongest amazon, as stated in thedatabook "Saint Seiya Taizen"and seen in the sequelSaint Seiya: Next Dimension. However,in the anime... Adaptational Wimp: In the anime, she frequently has to be rescued and loses almost every battle she stars in, including a friendly sparring match against Shaina (despite being stated as her equal) and even to several enemies far below Silver Saint level, including a bunch of regular Sanctuary soldiers (weaker than even the weakest of Bronze Saints) and a washout who was disqualified from eligibility to Sainthood (granted that the guy was a hulking brute, but he didn't know how to use Cosmo power at all). Aloof Ally: Although she works as a team with Shaina and the other Bronze Knights, she remains reserved, distant and tough. Big Brother Mentor: Ultimately subverted when it was revealed she wasn't Seiya's elder sister after all, with her younger brother being another warrior different from Seiya.

characters.name: Ophiuchus Shaina
characters.description: An aggressive female Saint, Shaina is the first opponent Seiya faces after earning the Pegasus Cloth, when she attacks him to avenge her pupil and Seiya's rival, Cassios. Though she tries to kill him on further occasions, she eventually becomes an ally to the heroes, in part because of Seiya seeing her face and the consequences thereof. The Ace: In the anime, she's the strongest Saint who did not awaken to the Seventh Sense, even toppingMisty. Even before Shaina became a Saint, she was known to Seiya as the toughest and fiercest of all the female Saint candidates in training. Adaptational Badass: She has several more attempts at assassinating Seiya in the 80s TV series, and almost succeeded. In addition, she practically beats Marin in every clash they have. Adaptation Dye-Job: She has black hair in the manga. Avenging the Villain: In the anime, she comes at Seiya to avenge the defeats of Cassios, Docrates,andGeist at his hands.

characters.name: Lizard Misty
characters.description: Narcissistic yet dangerous, Misty is a beautiful Silver Saint who has won many battles while never once being harmed or injured. He is among the first group of Silver Saints sent out to kill the Bronze Saints, and is the first to engage them in battle. The Ace: Perfect mission record, and never harmed, or even hit at all, before his final mission.Lampshadedin the anime: all the other Silver Saints held him in high regard, even Shaina (who is objectively more powerful, having survived the same technique that killed Misty), thinking he alone would be more than enough to kill them all-and making a point of avenging him after they get over the shock of his completely unexpected death. Adapted Out: Partially. In the anime, the parts given to anime-only Docrates were originaly Misty's in the manga. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Misty was very proud of his status as a Silver Saint, dismissed the Bronze Saints as something he could easily wipe out. But astonishingly not so much after Seiya defeated him. Awesomeness Is a Force: Finding outwhowas the guy who had just demanded his suicide scaredSeiya.

characters.name: Whale Moses (Cetus/Kaitos Mozes)
characters.description: A Silver Saint who is part of the group tasked with executing the Bronze Saints. Physically strong, he becomes even more dangerous when partnered with the telepathic Hound Asterion. Adaptational Ugliness: His manga counterpart looks younger and more handsome. Calling Your Attacks:Kaitos Spouting Bomber. The Brute: Is physically strong and tough looking, contrasting Asterion. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Has a scar on his left eye.

characters.name: Hound Asterion
characters.description: Part of the first group of Silver Saints, Asterion has the ability to read an opponent's mind and know what moves they plan to make. While this allows him to direct his allies, he's no slouch when fighting by himself. Calling Your Attacks:Satori no ho. Although not an attack per se, with it he can anticipate his enemies' movements, allowing him to easily counter their attacks. He used his ability against Marin, anticipating her moves and directing Moses' attacks and later against Seiya. The skill is useless if the enemy can create a vacuum in the mind, which Marin did to defeat him.Million Ghost Attack. Asterion uses his mind reading ability to anticipate his enemy moves, dodge them, and counter by striking at theirPressure Point. This technique is different in the anime version, where Asterion multiplicates himself, and all of his replicas attack at once with a single energy blast. Satori no ho. Although not an attack per se, with it he can anticipate his enemies' movements, allowing him to easily counter their attacks. He used his ability against Marin, anticipating her moves and directing Moses' attacks and later against Seiya. The skill is useless if the enemy can create a vacuum in the mind, which Marin did to defeat him. Million Ghost Attack. Asterion uses his mind reading ability to anticipate his enemy moves, dodge them, and counter by striking at theirPressure Point. This technique is different in the anime version, where Asterion multiplicates himself, and all of his replicas attack at once with a single energy blast. Death by Adaptation: In the manga, Marin spares him and directs him to return to Sanctuary; it's only in the Hades arc that we learnhe didn't live much longer past that. The anime, meanwhile, has Marin kill him outright.

characters.name: Centaurus Babel
characters.description: A Silver Saint with the power to control fire, dispatched to kill the "renegade" Bronze Saints alongside Misty, Moses, Asterion, and Marin. Adaptational Badass: While in the manga he iseasily defeatedby Hyoga, the anime adaptation made him powerful enough to hold his own against the five Bronze Saints. Calling Your Attacks:Fotia Roufihtra. Combat Pragmatist: In the anime he attacks Shun, Shiryuu and Ikki are without Cloth and Seiya is exhausted from going throughMisty, Moses and Asterion (the latter of which actually beat him), with Hyoga, the only one Clothed and not tired, being at disadvantage against his flames. He comes quite close to kill Hyoga, with the explicit intention of killing everyone else as soon as he was dealt with, before the Steel Saints show up. Death Equals Redemption: In the anime, he's moved by Saori's encouragement to fight for justice in his next life and succumbs to his wounds with a tear and a smile.

characters.name: Crow Jamian
characters.description: A Saint who is dispatched to abduct Saori, Jamian can control large murders of crows and use them to do his bidding, up to and including fighting his enemies. Attack Animal: His crows. Bald of Evil: He is bald in the manga only. Subverted in the anime. The Beastmaster: Jamian's reputation of being able to control crows is quite exaggerated. He boasts they almost function like a part of himself. Beware the Silly Ones: He may be an idiot and theButt-Monkey, but he'sstilla Silver Saint. Seiya learns this the hard way when Jamian uses the Black Wing Shift and nearly gets suffocated to death by his crows' feathers.

characters.name: Perseus Algol
characters.description: Part of the Silver Saint Squadron sent to kidnap Saori and retrieve the Saggitarius Gold Cloth. Algol wields the Medusa Shield, which petrifies those who look at it regardless of blindfolds or eyelids. Calling Your Attacks:R'has Al'Ghul Gorgoneio(which means "Head of the Ghoul Gorgoneion"). He leaps high into the air while he creates an illusion of tons of serpents and assaults his victim with a mighty kick, likely stronger than a regular kick due to its height, and possible Cosmo energy use. Genre Savvy: Think you can safely attack him by using reflections to see him, as Perseus did with Medusa? Too bad; he's well aware of that story and that trick, as Shiryu learns. Luckily, My Shield Will Protect Me: He relies heavily on his Medusa Shield, with the mere threat of it preventing Shiryu from using his full strength against Algol. Once Shiryublinds himselfand renders the shield's power useless, though, both it and Algol are struck down very quickly. No Eye in Magic: Averted. The shield's power works even if the target closes or covers their eyes, because it passes through blindfolds and eyelids and goes directly into the retinas. Of note, the Dragon Shield is actually strong enough to protect Shiryu from it, but he can't land a decisive blow against Algol whilealsokeeping his eyes shielded that way.

characters.name: Auriga Capella
characters.description: A Saint armed with two deadly saucers that can slice through flesh and act as boomerangs. He is part of the squadron of Silver Saints sent to retrieve the Sagittarius Gold Cloth, abduct Saori, and destroy the Graad Colosseum. Calling Your Attacks:Saucer Kogeki(Saucer Attack). Cruel and Unusual Death: He gets his hands sliced off and his chest cleaved open, all while hallucinating under the effects of Ikki'sMind Rapepunch. Deadly Disc: His "weapon" of choice, which is also part of his Cloth (given that the use of weapons is forbidden by Athena). Evil Redhead: Has red hair.

characters.name: Cerberus Dante
characters.description: A member of the secondary group of Silver Saints sent to Japan. His Cloth is armed with a pair of flails tipped with large morning stars. Calling Your Attacks:Jigoku no Kōkyūsa(Ball and Chain of Hell). Defiant to the End: Even after being warned by Ikki and having just witnessed Capela's death, he still attempts to attack Seiya and Saori, before being defeated by Nebula Chain. Disney Villain Death: Shun defeated Dante with his "Nebula Chain" in an instant and he falls down. Dub Name Change: Vesta in the Italian dub, forsome reason.

characters.name: Heracles Algethi
characters.description: One of three Silver Saints tasked with monitoring Aiolia when he is dispatched by the Pope to kill the Bronze Saints. Blow You Away: His Kornephoros sends the enemy flying with a whirlwind. The Brute: Much like Whale Moses, Algethi is a tough looking Saint who relies on brute force. He's acknowledged as possessing the highest brute strength of the Silver Saints and possesses the rough-and-tumble personality to go with it. Bullying a Dragon: SeeCurb-Stomp Battle. Calling Your Attacks:Kornephoros(Greek Kornephoros for Club Wielder).

characters.name: Musca Dio
characters.description: One of three Silver Saints tasked with monitoring Aiolia when he is dispatched by the Pope to kill the Bronze Saints. Avenging the Villain: Swore on his name that he would avenge the deaths of Misty and the other Silver Saints fallen in battle against the Bronzes. Bullying a Dragon: SeeCurb-Stomp Battle. Calling Your Attacks:Dead End Fly. Curb-Stomp Battle:They are easily defeated by Seiya who was being aided by the Sagittarius cloth.

characters.name: Canis Major Sirius
characters.description: One of three Silver Saints tasked with monitoring Aiolia when he is dispatched by the Pope to kill the Bronze Saints. Bullying a Dragon: SeeCurb-Stomp Battle. Calling Your Attacks:Great Mountain Smasher(anime only). Curb-Stomp Battle:They are easily defeated by Seiya who was being aided by the Sagittarius cloth. Dub Name Change: Orione in Italy, since "Sirio" was already taken (by Shiryu).

characters.name: Cepheus Daidalos/Albiore
characters.description: The master of Shun and June on Andromeda Island, who is represented by two different characters between the manga and anime continuities. In the manga, he is known as Daidalos, while in the anime he is called Albiore, with a different appearance. In both incarnations, he was a Saint who distrusted the corrupt Pope, and was killed for it by Pisces Aphrodite. Adaptational Attractiveness: In the anime, he had long blond hair and blue eyes and his Cloth was far more elaborate. Adaptational Badass: Daidalos was an average Silver Saint. His anime counterpart Albiore was not only the strongest Silver Saint revealed in the 1980s TV series with the power rivaling that the Gold Saints, he stalemated Milo and it took the direct intervention of Aphrodite to finally turn the tide. The original manga version Daidalos was killed so quick and easy there's not even a flashback. Adaptation Dye-Job: Short black hair in the manga, long blond hair in the anime. Ascended Extra: In the manga, Daidalos only appeared in one chapter, he only had June and Shun as his trainees. While he was described as strong,he died easily with Aphrodite standing over his body. Aphrodite himself couldbarely remember it.In the anime, Albiore was in five episodes, and strong enough to give a Gold Saint a run for their money,more handsome, had several students, and a couple of extra scenes including one where he taught the use of Cosmo to Shun.

characters.name: Sagitta Ptolemy
characters.description: A Silver Saint who poses as a guide when the Bronze Saints arrive at Sanctuary. He can create numerous illusory arrows to confuse his opponents. Annoying Arrows: Which turn out to be fake...except for the one that hits Saori. Calling Your Attacks:Phantom Arrow,Hunting Arrow Express. Curb-Stomp Battle: Seiya takes him out with pretty much one punch. Did You Just Punch Out Cthulhu?: The first Saint totake down a divinity in canon.

characters.name: Lyra Orphée
characters.description: A musically-gifted Saint who, despite being "merely" a Silver Saint, possesses a level of Cosmo that supposedly dwarfs even that of the Gold Saints. Despite this, he cares more for his love for music and for his lover Eurydice — for whom he's willing to brave even the Underworld itself. The Ace: His control of the Cosmo was so great that he gained the reputation of being above the level of Gold Saints, a reputation that even a lower ranking Bronze Saint like Seiya was aware of. It's also hinted that Orphée has awakened the Eighth Sense by the fact that he went into the Underworld remaining alive. Adaptation Dye-Job: He's blond in the manga and has a pink Cloth. Ambiguous Situation: It is notentirelyclear if he's meant to be the Orpheus who went to the Underworld for Eurydice, or someone who's life simply eerily resembles the original myth. The manga slightly implies the latter, but the anime seems to fully lean into the former. Brooding Boy, Gentle Girl: With Eurydice.

characters.name: Altar/Pope Ares
characters.description: The younger brother of the Pope of Sanctuary, who becomes the new Pope after the latter's death. Supplemental material for the anime revealed that Ares was also the Altar Saint, whose role was to act as the Pope's right-hand man. As a creation of the anime, Ares' story gets noticeably moreconvolutedas the manga's story asserts itself. For tropes pertaining to his actions as the Pope (and his true identity), seeSaint Seiya Gold Saints. Body Double: A third of the job of the Altar Saint is to operate as the Pope's body double. Canon Foreigner: In the manga, the Pope didn't have a younger brother or successor Continuity Snarl: In the manga, there was only one (nameless) Pope throughout the Sanctuary arc. The anime, however, introduces Ares as the Pope's evil younger brother, who takes over when he dies and serves as theBig Badfor the series. As the anime adapted more of the manga's story, however, it slowly drops the Ares narrative (with Seiya suggesting it was all just a cover story for a change in the original Pope's personality). Then,an anime guidebookwould claim that Aresdidexist, and thathe was whom Saga impersonated instead of Shion.

characters.name: Spartan
characters.description: Canon Foreigner: Only appeared in the anime. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Carried Shaina away and was never heard from again. However, he was likely killed by Pope Ares for failing his mission. Glowing Eyes of Doom: When he uses his powers to take down the aircraft. Gonk: When his eyes glow. Otherwise, he's pretty normal. Just look at the picture. Hoist by His Own Petard: He tries to hold Shiryuu's still so that Algol can petrify him, but he ends up getting a taste of Medusa's gaze when the Dragon Saint dodges out of his grasp.

characters.name: Tarantula Arachne
characters.description: Canon Foreigner: Doesn't exist in the manga. Big Creepy-Crawlies: The massive figure of a tarantula appears behind him as anAnimal Battle Aura. Oddly enough, his attack resembles a web. Bullying a Dragon: Beat up Seiya at the beginning of the fight until he got his Cloth and defeated him with one Ryusei Ken. Facial Markings: In the shape of a spider's legs. Filler Villain: He fight Seiya in a filler-episode.

characters.name: Peacock Shiva
characters.description: Filler Villain: Of two episode-arc where he is sent, along with Agora, to Kanon Island in search of Ikki, found there repairing his Cloth and healing his wounds, preparing to help his teammates battle being fought in the Sanctuary. Kick the Dog:Killing Helen's grandpa for not collaborating, then throwing the little girl into a volcano to "send her to Heaven" since after the ordeal her life would be miserable. Psychic Powers: Has the power of psychokinesis. Rapid-Fire Fisticuffs: His "Senju Kami Onken" technique (translated as "One Thousand Arms" in the LA dub). Sensitive Guy and Manly Man: Shiva is the Sensitive Guy, Agora is the Manly Man.

characters.name: Lotus Agora
characters.description: Evil Redhead: An evil warrior with red hair. Filler Villain: Of two episode-arc where he is sent, along with Shiva, to Kanon Island in search of Ikki, found there repairing his Cloth and healing his wounds, preparing to help his teammates in the battle being fought in the Sanctuary. Meditation Power Up: Subverted. Through meditation, he sends prayers to his teacher Shaka (who is still back in Sanctuary in the sixth House), who managed to paralyze Ikki with his Cosmo. Megaton Punch: His "Renge Bakusai Ken" technique (translated as "Lotus Explosion" in the LA dub) appears to be this. Psychic Powers: Has psychokinesis power.

characters.name: Aries Mu
characters.description: Mu is the third Gold Saint introduced in the story, initially known as the Cloth Blacksmith who repairs the Bronze Saints' cloths. A man of Jamir in the Himalayas, Mu is a descendant of the People of Mu, an ancient race from a lost continent which was destroyed during one of the Holy Wars between Athena and Poseidon. Mu is a student of the late previous Pope Shion, and he is the master of Kiki. A collected and doting man, Mu is considered one of the greatest allies of the Bronze Saints. Badass Pacifist: Shion commented that, due to Mu's pacifist nature, the first time he fought to kill his opponent was against Cancer Deathmask and Pisces Aphrodite resurrected as Specters. Barrier Warrior:Crystal Wall. Mu creates a transparent, glass-like barrier made of psychic force, between himself and an object. The strength of the wall is dependent on Mu's cosmo level; at 100%, it is nearly unbreakable to almost all but Mu's mentor who taught him the technique, Aries Shion. Beware the Nice Ones: He's a nice guy, he's calm and polite but don't push this guy too hard or you'll take a Stardust Revolution right to your face. Big Brother Mentor: To Shiryu.

characters.name: Taurus Aldebaran
characters.description: Aldebaran is a towering, intimidating Saint, who is basically a wall incarnate. Considered the physically strongest of the Gold Saints, Aldebaran is aBoisterous Bruiser, who is actually a friendly individual. Acrofatic: Despite being the bulkiest of the Golds, he is the fastest of them. Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is blonde in the manga, and purple or dark brown in the animes. Badass Arm-Fold: His battle stance (with crossed arms) allowed him to attack and defend at the same time. See pic! The Big Guy: Aldebaran is the biggest, tallest and physically strongest Gold Saint. In canon, he may be the tallest and largest Saint overall (maybe surpassed by the anime-only Docrates, who may be taller but is less bulky than Aldebaran).

characters.name: Gemini Saga
characters.description: Considered the informal leader of the Gold Saints, Saga is considered an example to follow by every Saint in the Sanctuary. However, much like his zodiac sign, there are two sides to Saga, making him a key central figure on the irregularities happening at the Sanctuary. Adaptational Badass: In the manga, he takes only on Seiya and Ikki in sucession and, while survives, is pretty much defeated when Seiya unleashes a Suiseiken with the same strength as his Galaxian Explosion. In the anime, meanwhile, he survive a combined attack from all five main Bronze Saints.Soul of Goldturns his Another Dimension technique into aSwiss-Army Superpower, which Saga can use to swallow multiple enemy attacks, or transport himself and others to another place. In the main series, the only thing he ever does with it is to send opponents to another dimension, leaving them stranded there forever. Soul of Goldturns his Another Dimension technique into aSwiss-Army Superpower, which Saga can use to swallow multiple enemy attacks, or transport himself and others to another place. In the main series, the only thing he ever does with it is to send opponents to another dimension, leaving them stranded there forever. Adaptational Villainy: In the Italian dub, Gemini's dark side openly refers to himself as the "Lord of all the Forces of Darkness and Evil" during his battle against Seiya and Ikki. Adaptation Dye-Job: Saga is a blond and his evil side's hair is black in the manga. In the anime, he has blue hair that turns gray when he becomes evil.

characters.name: Cancer Deathmask/Mephisto
characters.description: A cruel, murderous and bloodthirsty Saint, and an unabashed villain. A firm believer ofMight Makes Right, Deathmask decorates the Cancer Temple with the souls of his victims represented by masks that pang in agony and wrath. Deathmask's powers have him tread in the fringes of life and death, where he can cast his opponents into the hellish abyss. Adaptational Wimp: He's a frequent cannon fodder villain in the anime movies alongside Aphrodite. Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is gray in the manga, and blue in the anime. Badass Teacher:"Gigantomachia"(set between the Sanctuary and Poseidon arcs) states he's Mei's late instructor. Considering just how strong Mei is, he did a good job. Black Sheep: He is the only Saint that has been stripped of his armor and status after proving himself unworthy.

characters.name: Leo Aiolia
characters.description: A noble, stalwart and no-nonsense young man, Aiolia is the younger brother of the late Sagittarius Aiolos. Striving to become a paragon of the Gold Saints, Aiolia has always sought to prove he's not the same traitor his brother has been labeled as. Though a nice and accessible individual as a whole, Aiolia is markedlyHot-Bloodedand relentlessly fierce, appropriate for the Leo saint. Allegiance Affirmation: Of the nine Gold Saints who begin the series aligned with Sanctuary and its false Pope, Aiolia is the first to pledge Athena his loyalty in defiance of them. Big Brother Worship: Even after he was framed as a traitor, Aiolia always loved and respected his brother andpromised he would become stronger than his brother to clean his name.Subverted in the anime, where Aiolia came to hate Aiolos(though still speaks of him in high regard) but quickly drops this when he learns the truth. Subverted in the anime, where Aiolia came to hate Aiolos(though still speaks of him in high regard) but quickly drops this when he learns the truth. Brainwashed and Crazy: Saga attacked Aiolia with his "Genrou Mao Ken", allowing him to manipulate Aiolia's mind to kill the Bronze Saints.Only Cassios'Heroic Sacrificemanaged to de-brainwash him,which greatly affects him.

characters.name: Virgo Shaka
characters.description: Stated to be the Saint who is closest to God, Shaka is a larger-than-life Saint with overwhelming powers while wearing an indelible face of serenity. Facing Shaka in combat is close to facing the wrath of God. Adaptational Badass: Downplayed. In the manga, while facing-off against Saga, Shura and Camus during the Hades Arc, Shaka just dodges their punches and kicks; while in the OVA, he tanks their strongest attacks combined (Galactic Explosion + Exalibur + Aurora Execution) with his barrier. Also, while in the OVA Shaka is capable of holding his own against Shura and Camus combined in hand to hand combat, in the Manga, Camus froze his knee with a simple Diamond Dust, which caused Shaka a considerable amount of pain. He and his opponents still end up in the same state afterwards as in the manga, the animation team just couldn't pass up giving a bit of extra flair to such aninsanefight. Adaptational Personality Change: In the Italian dub, Virgo is much less of a stoic and wise buddha and can be quite a case ofEvil Is Hammy, for example sounding genuinely terrified whenIkki is about to take him out with anHeroic Sacrifice. He also shows a tendency toLawful Stupid, as he claims that he never considered the chance of the Pope being evil because traditionally the Pope always was Athena's chosen vassal. Adaptational Villainy: Shaka was far more arrogant in the Sanctuary Arc's anime version, to the point of creating an episode where Shaka sent his disciples to kill Ikkiandintervene in the duel until Saori sent out her own Cosmo. This caused some fans who only watched the anime to wonder why Shaka seemed to behave differently in Hades arc, as this arc followed Shaka's characterization from the manga more closely. Anti-Hero: Type IV. While his heart is in the right place (The Hades Sanctuary arc implying he's something akin toThe Heartof the Gold Saints collectively), he can also be VERY unscrupulous regarding his methods and like the Buddha he's based on, he's not really th

characters.name: Libra Dohko
characters.description: The old master that dwells in Rozan, Dohko is a survivor of the previous holy war and the guardian of the Seal of Athena, as well as Dragon Shiryu's master and Shunrei's caretaker. Given a prolonged life by Athena, Dohko took the guise of "Roshi" by using the Misophetamenos technique awarded to him by Athena. An authoritative figure among the Saints due to his long age, Dohko is often consulted even by other Gold Saints for guidance. In the manga after the Sanctuary Saga, Dohko adopted informally the role of Pope while still dwelling in Rozan. Achilles in His Tent: Justified.Athena (from the previous holy war) ordered him to watch Hades' seal, and prepare for the time the new holy war would begin. Amazing Technicolor Population: Like an old guy he has purple skin... for some reason. Animal Motifs: Unusual is that his symbolic creature, seen when his draws his full power, is neither the Libra nor a dragon, but a tiger. Even his Libra Cloth's helmetis loosely shaped like a tiger's head◊.

characters.name: Scorpio Milo
characters.description: A shoot-first-ask-questions-later kind of individual, Milo is initially shown as one not to question the will of the Pope, mainly as an indifferent instrument of his schemes. However, meeting the Bronze Saints make him question himself and his choices. Adaptation Dye-Job: Milo has blonde hair in the manga, and blue hair in the anime. Bloody Horror: Racking up enough wounds from his Scarlet Needle barrage results in this. Hyoga is aghast at the bloody mess of himself after taking fourteen of the fifteen strikes. Calling Your Attacks:Restriction: Milo uses his Cosmo energy to stop the movements of his opponents. The Italian dub christens this technique "Onde dello Scorpione" (Scorpion's Waves).Scarlet Needle/Scarlet Stinger (ADV dub): Milo launches a crimson fingernail on his index fingernotein the anime, it grows from regular length to a vicious red talon when needed, and goes away after the attackto 14 parts of the body to poison opponents, make them bleed, and scream in pain, losing their 5 senses in the process. The attack is impossible to divert or defend against. Each needle strike matches and represents one of the stars of the Scorpio constellation. He can shoot however many needles he wants at the same time up to 14 and even in multiple targets. The holes of the needles draw a miniature of the Scorpio constellation on the body of the victim.Finishing Move:Scarlet Needle Antares: The final attack of the Scarlet Needle and the main point of Scorpio. If the rival has not yet been defeated after 14 Scarlet Needles, Milo uses Antares. Whoever receives 14 Scarlet Needles and Antares will die. Restriction: Milo uses his Cosmo energy to stop the movements of his opponents. The Italian dub christens this technique "Onde dello Scorpione" (Scorpion's Waves).

characters.name: Sagittarius Aiolos
characters.description: The late Saint of Sagittarius, whose last effort in life kickstarted the story. Once thought of as a paragon of Athena's Saints, Aiolos was labeled as a traitor by the Pope for his supposed killing attempt of the baby Athena. Having scampered the baby out of the Sanctuary after fending off attacks from other Saints, Aiolos stumbled upon a tourist, Mitsumasa Kido, informing him with his last breath of the girl's identity and to protect her life. Aiolos was the older brother of Leo Aiolia. The Ace: Aiolos always was a paragon of righteousness, seen as the perfect Saint and one of the two Gold Saints who could succeed Aries Shion as the next Pope of Sanctuary and the chosen one. Arc Words: His testament, quoted abovenoteIn the original, it's written in perfect Greek, in the Sagittarius temple becomes this for the series as a whole. The wall has endured all the way intoSaint Seiya Omegaeven with the radical restructuring of the Twelve Houses. Big Brother Mentor: To Aioliaand to Seiya,from beyond the grave.

characters.name: Capricorn Shura
characters.description: The self-professed most loyal Saint to Athena who, under orders from the Pope thirteen years before, delivered the attack that ended up killing the fleeing Sagittarius Aiolos. A tremendously proud and unrelenting Saint, meeting the Bronze Saints makes him face the fact that said attack upon Aiolos is nothing to be proud of. Adaptational Heroism: The anime version elevates him from his status asone of Saga's followersfrom the manga to Athena's self-proclaimed most faithful Saint, probably due to him beingthe only one of the three to repent before his death. Other adaptations and spin-offs tend to favour this portrayal over the original, to the point that many fans up to this day remain unaware of this fact. Absurdly Sharp Blade: Has Excalibur in his arms...and legs!!! Always with You: His loyalty to Athena endures through Shiryu, in whose right arm Shura imbued his spirit, along with his signature technique Excalibur. An Arm and a Leg: He has one arm broken by Shiryu in a riskyDeliberate Injury Gambit, and then has the other oneentirely severedwhen Shiryu goes for his Rozan Koryu Ha.

characters.name: Aquarius Camus
characters.description: The master of Cygnus Hyoga (of the Crystal Saint in the anime adaptation, who is in turn Hyoga's master) and Kraken Isaac. He seeks to stop Hyoga from antagonizing the Gold Saints because he doesn't deem him strong enough. ASink-or-Swim Mentorfor Hyoga, Camus is shown to be dispassionate and cold, though there is a purpose to his methods. Adaptation Dye-Job: In the manga, he's a redhead. Badass Teacher: To Hyoga and Isaac. Considering just how strong Hyoga is, he did a good job. Beam-O-War: How his duels with Hyoga go. Being his master (or his master's master, in the anime) he doesn't need to test Hyoga's skills or improve his technique anymore; what he wants to see is Hyoga's Cosmo burn—er,freezecolder than it ever has before, and the best way to do that is to stand there and pit his own Cosmo against his student's and see whose beam freezes whom first. Beyond the Impossible: Camus claims that Gold Cloths freeze at absolute-zero. He states that even he can't reach such a temperature, which he believes to be impossible; and that in order for Hyoga to defeat him, he must reach a freezing cold equal to that. Most of his attitude towards Hyoga stems from that belief. He is properly flabbergasted when Hyoga goes and achieves it anyway, not caring about what is possible or not.This is very iconic of shounen/nekketsu tropes, and Camus seems to realize on some level that as an adult, his prejudice prevents him from breaking his own limits; this is implied to be one reason why Saints are meant to be teenagers. One can wonder whether Camus decided to actively embrace the role of the aloof villain/adult/teacher to push the hero/teenager/student to break his own limits and achieve what he could not do.

characters.name: Pisces Aphrodite
characters.description: Considered the most dangerous Gold Saint, Aphrodite is a vain and cruel Saint with very little purpose to fighting other than to amuse himself. Adaptational Badass: Aphrodite fares much better during fights in the spin-offs, likeEpisode.GandSoul of Goldthan in the main work. Adaptational Wimp: Twice in the original work.In the Sanctuary arc (anime version), Saga tried to subvert this by making a extra monologue on how Aphrodite is the most feared Gold Saint; despite that, he fared no better against Shun than in the manga. The anime also changed his defeat of Shun's mentor by placing a small filler scene where he "cheats" during a fight between Milo and the Cepheus Saint by snipping the latter, with a poisoned rose, from behind.In the manga, during the Hades arc, Aphrodite and Deathmask are defeated by Mu and sent back to the underworld, where Rhadamanthys simply thrown them into the Cocytus prison as punishment for their failurenote(since they where secretly on Shion's side, it's unlikely that they tried to resist, as it might have exposed the others). In the anime, they show up in Hades castle (in Germany) for some reason, and kill some foot soldiers, before being confronted by Rhadamanthys, whoNo-Selltheir attacks and effortlessly defeats them. It does not help that Aphrodite dieswhile begging for mercy.In the anime movies, Aphrodite and Deathmask are usually shown as cannon fodder. In the Sanctuary arc (anime version), Saga tried to subvert this by making a extra monologue on how Aphrodite is the most feared Gold Saint; despite that, he fared no better against Shun than in the manga. The anime also changed his defeat of Shun's mentor by placing a small filler scene where he "cheats" during a fight between Milo and the Cepheus Saint by snipping the latter, with a poisoned rose, from behind. In the manga, during the Hades arc, Aphrodite and Deathmask are defeated by Mu and sent back to the underworld, where Rhadamanthys simply thrown them into the Cocytus prison as

characters.name: The Pope / Aries Shion
characters.description: The previous user of the Aries Golden Cloth, Mu's master and the former pope before his execution at the hands of the imposter, Saga. Like Dohko, Shion is a survivor from the holy war two hundred years ago. Ascended Extra: Shion appears for a couple of episodeswhen he was resurrected for twelve hours by Hadesand later on becomes one of the main characters in both Lost Canvas and Next Dimension. Big Good: Held this position in the backstory, before Athena was reincarnated into the world. As the former Pope, he resumes this role for as longas his life lastsafter Athena'sHeroic Sacrifice.Shion: As the Pope, I order you: Now is the time to crush Hades' ambitions! Make for his castle, and vanquish Hades now! Calling Your Attacks:Stardust Revolution: The attack summons stardust from stars and galaxies then throws million of blows instantly. It's well known that the attack has force of shooting stars and comets and obliterates an enemy with raw cosmos power.Crystal Wall: Shion creates a transparent, glass-like barrier made of psycho-power, between him and an object. The wall is very durable, and has been shown to shield him against everything from normal Cosmos attacks to poison scent and rebounding the attack back to the enemy with the same strength it was launched.Starlight Extinction: It's a teleportation-based offensive technique, although it's essence relies not on destroying the opponent but on removing him from battle.The Taizen implies this technique is his despite being only used by Mu. Stardust Revolution: The attack summons stardust from stars and galaxies then throws million of blows instantly. It's well known that the attack has force of shooting stars and comets and obliterates an enemy with raw cosmos power.

characters.name: Guilty
characters.description: Abusive Parents: In the anime is one to Esmeralda, Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is black in the manga. Asshole Victim: He was really a cruel man, no surprise that Ikki certainly did not cry for his death. Death Is Gray: Anime only, when Guilty finally dies (without saying any words) after being fatally hit by Ikki, his mask becomes completely ash gray. In the manga, it falls off his face (which remains unseen) and shatters as he dies. Drill Sergeant Nasty: He is extremely brutal while training Ikki and insults and berates him at every second. It was routine for Ikki to be wounded and severely beaten up to the point of unconsciousness by this guy.

characters.name: Jango
characters.description: Curb-Stomp Battle: Ikki defeats him easily. The Don: Said in the anime to be the leader of ALLthe mafiasand terrorist groups in the world. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Half of his face is horribly burned, as you can see. Mind Rape: How Ikki deals with him. He sees himself falling and melting in the lava of Death Queen Island. Obviously Evil: Is the leader of the Black Saints (in the manga, before Ikki claims the Phoenix Cloth from him, in the anime after Seiya rescues Saori from Jamian).

characters.name: The Black Saints
characters.description: Alas, Poor Villain: Black Dragon as he dies after clashing with Shiryu, touched by his counterpart's belief in friendship, and deciding to save his life before dying himself.In the manga, Seiya feels this way for them when they are all killed by the Silver Saints after being tricked by Mu's illusions that made them think that they have killed the real Bronze Saints instead. Because of this, Seiya swears to fight the Silver Saints on their behalf as well. In the manga, Seiya feels this way for them when they are all killed by the Silver Saints after being tricked by Mu's illusions that made them think that they have killed the real Bronze Saints instead. Because of this, Seiya swears to fight the Silver Saints on their behalf as well. Adapted Out: In the original manga, Black Dragon had a twin, who does not appear in the anime version. InSaint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac, they are replaced by completely different characters. Black Eyes of Crazy: Black Dragon. Canon Immigrant: Black Phoenix exists only in the anime. In the manga, Phoenix Ikki still had his army ofMooksall dressed in black versions of the Phoenix Cloth (these are also seen in the anime adaptation), but being simply Mooks, none of them had actual Cosmo powers or any special techniques (and even their black clothes did not regenerate like the real Phoenix Cloth would), so none of them could possibly be called "Black Phoenix". The anime-exclusive Black Phoenix looked exactly as one of these Mooks, but he had Cosmo power and was capable of at least one special technique, "Ankoku Genma Ken", which appeared to be a lesser version of Ikki's Hōyoku Tenshō mixed with his Phoenix Genma Ken as well.

characters.name: Crystal Saint
characters.description: Animal Motifs: A blue swan. Brainwashed and Crazy: The Pope pulled this on him, thus forcing Hyoga to kill him. The Coats Are Off: Removes his cape before fighting seriously. Decomposite Character: Is the master of Hyoga in the anime and the substitute to Camus in all the flashbacks of the training. Dying as Yourself: After being struck to death by Hyoga, he regains control of himself and, as his last act, destroys the ice pyramid built for Arles by Gigas and collapses into the arms of his pupil. Before giving up the ghost, he asks for forgiveness for what he had done to Hyoga.

characters.name: Geist
characters.description: Animal Motif: Leans intoSnakes Are Sinisterwith her use Thunder Claw, but her fanged mask, spooky castle, and forest full of vampire bats give her aBat Out of Hellveneer. Beautiful All Along: Without her mask, to the viewers surprise. Cool Mask: Geist mask has fangs and facial markings similar to Shaina's mask, but they run down the cheeks of the mask, like tears. The mask is also locked into a sneer, whereas the masks of Athena's saints are completely expressionless. Dark Action Girl: Just like Shaina, whom she respects like a sister. Death Equals Redemption: Downplayed. She vows to tell all in the unlikely event Seiya manages to defeat her, which he does, but she chooses to keep her pride in her final moments and not betray her link to Sanctuary. For all that, she receives a halfway sympathetic end and Seiya does not exult in her death.

characters.name: Ghost Saints
characters.description: Anti-Climax Boss: Shiryu defeats Dolphin with almostcontemptuousease. Dub Name Change: Dolphin was called "Tiburón" ("Shark") in the Latin American dub. Electric Jellyfish: Jellyfish can release a powerful electrical discharge through the tentacles. The Faceless: You never see their face. Filler Villain: Of Geist's arc.

characters.name: Steel Saints
characters.description: Animal Motifs: The Toucan, Fox, and Swordfish, respectively. Big Damn Heroes: The point of their existence is to occasionally bail out the Bronze Saints. However, their success is directly tied to the element of surprise and how disconcerting their very existence is to regular Saints—any legitimate Saint wise to their appearance can mop the floor with them with little trouble. Canon Foreigner: They appear only in the anime. (and inSaint Seiya Omeganow) Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: They kind of just...disappear when Seiya and the gang leave for Sanctuary. They're last seen when Shun arrives at the meeting place carrying June but aren't shown boarding or being on the plane afterwords. Oddly enough,they are still shown on the eyecatchesfor the rest of the Sanctuary arc despite their absence. They end appearing again inSaint Seiya Omega. Cool Board: Daichi cantransformhis cloth into one.

characters.name: Docrates
characters.description: Avenging the Villain: He is Cassios' older brother. Docrates tells Seiya that it's his fault Cassios did not become a Saint and he is now going to avenge him. The Big Guy: Docrates may be the tallest Saint shown in the anime, perhaps surpassing Taurus Aldebaran. This is not the case in the manga, since Docrates is anime-only. Blow You Away: In the attack,Heracles Fierce Onslaught Fist, Docrates crosses, then flexes his arms, concentrating his Cosmo in his fists and causing the winds around of him to change due to the pressure. Next, he attacks with both fists, projecting two powerful blasts which affect a large area. The Brute: A cold and aggressive character, full of mischief. He has extremely high physical strength derived from its huge size and musculature. Canon Foreigner: His first appearance is parallel to the appearance of Lizard Misty in the manga. After that, the story diverges.

characters.name: Saint of Fire
characters.description: Curb-Stomp Battle: He was painfully curbstomped by Ikki. Evil Redhead: Maybe. Like most fighters sanctuary this time, he doesn't know the Pope is a fake and believing that could mean for him that he thought he was following Athena's will. However, he seems to have a sadistic and cruel nature, given the pleasure he has in torturing Shun with his flames. Filler Villain: He is a warrior under Gigas' command, accompanying the latter to Japan in a last attempt to recover the helmet of the Gold Cloth of Sagittarius. He is an anime-only character. Malevolent Masked Man No Name Given: His real name and constellation is unknown.Fanonhas given him the constellation of Fornax (The Furnace)

characters.name: Leda and Spica
characters.description: Ambiguous Situation: It is not known if they have died after fighting Shun, or only get knocked out (because Shun does not usually kill his opponents unless necessary). However, one of them is confirmed to be at least given some very nastyEye Screampayback. Religious and Mythological Theme Naming: Named after Leda, the queen of Sparta who was seduced by Zeus as a Swan. No Name Given: Their constellations. Somefanonsources give Spica's constellation as Cassiopeia and speculate Cassiopeia, Bootes, Austral Fish or Male Hydra for Reda. Palette Swap: Save for the heads, shoulder pieces and chain ends, their armors too have man boobs. The Rivals: Like Shun, they were candidates to obtain the bronze Andromeda Cloth.

characters.name: Polaris Hilda
characters.description: The Priestess of Asgard and Odin's representative on Earth. Corrupted by forces unknown at the time (later revealed to be the Nibelungen Ring), Hilda commands the God Warriors on her quest for world domination. Hilda is Freya's older sister. Adaptational Badass: In thePS3game "Brave Soldiers", she is a playable character. And I Must Scream: After she was freed, it's revealed that Poseidon locked her spirit away in the Nibelung Ring as her body was controlled by him, torturing her psychologically while she could only watch her warriors die one by one. Arc Villain: Of the Asgard saga. Also serves as theFinal Bossonce her God Warriors are defeated, with the wrinkle that killing her would doom the world.

characters.name: Freya
characters.description: Freya is Hilda's younger sister and the person who informs Saori Kido and the Bronze Saints about Hilda's corruption. She is a childhood friend of Siegfried and Hagen. She forms a tender friendship with Hyoga. The Bus Came Back: She reappears inSaint Seiya: Soul of Goldas a cameo. Childhood Friend Romance: An unrequited example, towards her childhood friend Hagen. She asks Hagen to help the Saints of Athena, in order to save her sister, but thisenrages him, as he thinks Hyoga has convinced Freya to turn against Asgard and attacks them both. Hyoga is then forced to kill him. Defector from Decadence: Freya noticed a dark change in the personality of her sister, as Hilda had been noted for her kindness and compassion. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Has long blonde hair and is very nice.

characters.name: Dubhe Alpha Siegfried
characters.description: Siegfried is Hilda's second-in-command and most loyal servant. He is Hilda and Freya's childhood friend. True to his myth namesake, Siegfried is effectively invulnerable save for a small area on his back. He is a fearsome warrior known for his loyalty. The Ace: Good lord, no wonder he was Hilda's personal bodyguard. Siegfried goes through the Bronze Saints like a hot knife through butter. EvenSorrento, part of Poseidon's army which had played Asgard like a fiddle, was hit with a bad case of cold sweat when he realized Siegfried was coming for him, dead or alive. Achilles' Heel: The spot where a leaf landed on the mythological Siegfried while he was bathing in dragon's blood, coincidentally over this Siegfried's heart. Shiryu designs anIndy Ployaround hitting it since he suffered from a similar weakness and now knows how to exploit it. Animal Motif: The Dragon, just like Shiryu. His is the dragon Fafnir from theNibelungenliedrather than a ChineseLong, since he's Nordic. Fafnir is usually associated with bottomless greed and abuse of power, but Siegfried, per his namesake, is instead associated with valor, bottomless strength and toughness and more tragically,Senseless Sacrifice. Anti-Villain: He is a really noble and good-hearted warrior loyal to Hilda who only fights with his homeland's interests in mind. Seiya tells Siegfried that Hilda was under the control of the Nibelung ring, but unfortunately he doesn't believe it until Sorrento shows up, at which point Siegfriedflips his lidand takes Sorrento with him in death as recompense for the God Warriors' actions.

characters.name: Merak Beta Hagen
characters.description: Hagen is a childhood friend of Hilda and Freya and a member of Asgard's Imperial Guard. He is unique among allSaint Seiyacharacters due to his command of both ice and fire powers. Hagen is fiercely loyal, but has a volatile and jealous personality, which puts him in conflict with Hyoga, who had befriended Freya. All for Nothing: Hyoga bitterly reflects that Hagen could have stood on the side of right and lent his strength to Freya's cause, which would have saved Hilda; instead, he attacks Freya in Hilda's name and dies for nothing. Hagen's last wordspoint to regretand Hyoga regards his victory as a wasteful and hollow one. Animal Motifs: Horse (Sleipnir). Conflicting Loyalty: When Freya sets herself against Hilda, Haden must choose to enforce the will of the queen whose cause he believes in or believe in the girl he loves. In the end, he sides with Hilda over Freya, a decision implicitly made by his resentment over Freya's closeness to Hyoga. Crazy Jealous Guy: He loves Freya and upon learning that she had left Asgard with Hyoga, he flew into a rage and chased the Cygnus Saint in an apparent fit of jealousy. This got worse when she prevented him from throwing Hyōga's body in the magma.

characters.name: Phecda Gamma Thor
characters.description: Thor is aGentle Giantwho ends up fighting for the sake of Hilda out of loyalty, being personally familiar with her kindness otherwise. Animal Motifs: His God Robe bears the likeness of the Great Serpent Jormungand, depicted as a giant snake with a hood, but Thor himself has little to no snake traits. Because You Were Nice to Me: Originally, Thor had no respect for Hilda as an aloof presence in Asgard, but herHealing Handsand sympathy for his plight alerted him to her noble character and earned hisUndying Loyalty. The Brute: For the God Warriors. He is really big and strong, but is also a very nice guy. He was tasked with taking Freya to a cell for disagreeing with Hilda, but he openly questioned the order and was visibly NOT okay with having to go through with it. Dual Wielding: Thor wields twin axes named 'Mjolnir' (the Italian dub has him calling them "hammers" anyway).

characters.name: Megrez Delta Alberich
characters.description: Alberich is a shrewd and cunning warrior who serves Hilda for his own sake. He is extremely intelligent and calculating, but was often scolded by the non-corrupted Hilda using his potential for selfish reasons. He is aware of Hilda's corruption and plans to usurp her. Big Bad Wannabe: One might surmise that Alberich's status asThe Starscreamand success in defeating a Silver Saint and two Bronze Saints (and only failing to defeat a third because of a single tactical error) would mean that he would have been one of the final obstacles in the Asgard arc. He's instead brought low well before that, when several of the Odin Sapphires were still not accounted for. Black Sheep: None of the other God Warriors trust him in the very least, and they're right not to do so. Combat Pragmatist: Since he has a weak body but quite versatile powers, he uses thoseandhis knowledge without any mercy. Crystal Prison: Anastyversion. He can summon the "Amethyst Sealed" —an attack that sends shards of amethyst flying from his body and towards the enemy, encasing him or her in a shell of translucent gemstone. If they're not freed, victims will be robbed of their lifeforce, and eventually become skeletons trapped in amethyst. And the only way to really free them is to kill Alberich himself.That almost happens to Marin and later Seiya, and Shiryu has to save them both via fighting Alberich to the death.

characters.name: Alioth Epsilon Fenrir
characters.description: A half-feral warrior who was descended from a noble family that fell to ruin after the untimely death of his parents. Raised by wolves from a young age, Fenrir is tremendously resentful of the world. Alas, Poor Villain:Fenrir dies pitied by Shiryu, who wishes him the experiences of love and friendship in his next life. Animal Motifs: Wolf obviously. (Fenrir) Avenging the Villain: Ging and the other surviving wolves turn their fangs on Shiryuafter he kills their master. Break the Cutie: His backstory. Fenrir was the son of one of the most powerful and rich families in Asgard. One day, when he and his family went hunting, they were attacked by a bear. Abandoned by humans but saved by wolves, he started to live with them, adopting their lifestyle and developing a deep hatred towards humans. Which leads him to cross theDespair Event Horizonand become aWoobie, Destroyer of Worlds.

characters.name: Mizar Zeta Syd
characters.description: The son of a wealthy and loving family, Syd is a proud warrior who is sent to the Sanctuary to slay Taurus Aldebaran, later heading to the Kido Mansion to attack Saori, thus announcing Asgard's hostilities against her and the Bronze Saints. Always Someone Better: Forhis twin Alcor. Animal Motifs: Tigers. Cain and Abel:And maybe one of the most tragic cases ever, as he always knew who Bud was and genuinely cared for him,but could never tell him that he did.. Curb-Stomp Battle: He faces off with a few of the minor Bronze Saints, dispatching Jabu, Ban, Nachi, Ichi and Geki with a flick of the hand. Heseeminglydelivered one to Aldebaran, buttheir powers were comparable, so his twin brother took the Saint unawares.

characters.name: Alcor Zeta Bud
characters.description: Bud is Syd's twin brother, who was shunned by their family due to superstition against twins. Syd deeply resents Bud for his life of privilege with their parents, and follows bud like a shadow at Hilda's orders. An Ice Person:Uses a similar attack to his brother. Far more powerful though. Animal Motifs: White tiger Byakko, in opposition to Phoenix Ikki as Suzaku. Big Brother Instinct:He'll probably deny it too. Born Unlucky: And how!On the day he and his twin, Syd were born, Bud was cast out due to a superstitious belief in Asgard that twins were a sign of disaster. And Bud was left to die in a blizzard. Fortunately, he was found and adopted by a poor family. Syd, on the other hand, remained with their wealthy parents and wanted for nothing while Bud's family struggled just for food. Bud thought life was turning around for him when he was chosen to be a God Warrior, only to find out he was not only an unofficial member of the group, but his purpose was nothing more than to guard his twin brother as his shadow. Meaning Syd always received 100% of the credit even when Bud contributed to his success. It's not hard to see why Bud was so eager for Syd to finally slip up and die, because it was the only way for Bud to ever step out of the shadows and have a life of his own.Bud got screwed over from day one due to factors that were always outside his ability to control.

characters.name: Benetnasch Eta Mime
characters.description: A warrior raised with resentment by the man who killed his parents. Mime is a deeply traumatized and unstable young man. Abusive Parents: His adoptive father Volker abused him because he preferred to play the harp rather than fighting.Or so he thinks. Badass Pacifist: Initially Shun could not use the Andromeda chains to attack him, because they did not recognize Mime as an enemy. He easily beats Shun within an inch of his life, and gave such a hell of a fight to Ikki that he collapsed from exhaustion afterwards. Break Them by Talking: Reduces Shun to doubt and despair with somearmor-piercing questionsabout his battle history. Expy: To Lyra Orpheus of the first Saint Seiya movie. He plays the same melody on his harp.

characters.name: Mermaid Thetis
characters.description: Adaptational Badass: A minor example, as the anime gives her a special technique, "Death Trap Coral", which makes corals grow on her opponents, immobilizing and suffocating them. She uses it to entrap Seiya and Shun, but they break free from it with sheer determination and Cosmo power. Affably Evil: Very polite and soft-spoken, until she fights. But Now I Must Go: Anime-only, when she changed back to her mermaid form and leaves. Designated Girl Fight: Though shedoesgive Shaina quite a run for her money. Forgotten Fallen Friend:Justified with her death in the manga, as Julian lost his memory and Sorrento doesn't know what Thetis fish form looked like.

characters.name: Sea Horse Baian
characters.description: Badass Cape: The only other Mariner besides Sea Dragon to have one. Its destruction at the hands of Seiya punctuated the later'sHeroic Second Wind. Barrier Warrior: His effective invisible shield was nothing more than an air current created by his hands. Blow You Away: He attacked Seiya using his mightyGod Breath, which was a gale of immense destructive force. Flat Character: By far the least developed Mariner. He's just a generic villain for Seiya to kick ass. Foil: To Seiya. He's the marine horse (Hippocampus) to his aerial horse. (Pegasus)

characters.name: Scylla Io
characters.description: The Beastmaster: His main power is to summon the abilities of six creatures (a wolf, a bear, a bat, a giant bee, an eagle and a snake). Blow You Away: His secret attackBig Tornado. Bowdlerise: Downplayed, the Italian dub specifies that the animals used by Scylla are actually illusions, while in the manga and original dub the summoned beasts are real. Possibly to downplay the violent image of Shun being mauled by wild beasts. Defiant to the End: Prefers to go down fighting towards Shundespitebeing bound in chains, trying to block Shun's direct attack (via Libra Cloth's weapons) on the pillar he protected. Shun is very impressed at hisUndying Loyaltyto Poseidon and expresses sadness at his passing. Didn't Think This Through: Not using the full power of his beasts the first time around proved to be a big mistake, as by the time he wanted to finish off Shun, he - and the Andromeda Chain - had figured a way to neutralize each of them.

characters.name: Chrysaor Krishna
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: In Kurumada's manga, Krishna's hair is blonde. In the anime adaptation, it was modified to white to generate a better color balance and contrast. Armor-Piercing Attack: Chrysaor wields a Golden Lance capable of piercing through every known defense. Chrysaor's spear soon proves its piercing power by easily breaking through Shiryu's Cloth and its fabled Dragon Shield. It is important to note that, despite what the manga tells you, Chrysaordoesn'tmean "golden lance", but "golden sword", making this one one of the huge liberties ofSaint Seiyawith Greek Mythology and language. Curb-Stomp Battle: The one he first dishes out to Shiryu is particularly brutal. The indomitable shield of the Dragon is pierced like paper, and Shiryu bitterly reflects that he now knows what it feels like to lose a battle ineveryrespect. Ironic Name: Unintentional example. The manga claims Chrysaor means "golden lance", hence his weapon of choice. In reality, his name means "golden sword", which is ironic considering Shiryu destroyed his pillar with the sword of the Capricorn Gold Cloth's Excalibur wielded by a mere bronze. Meditation Powerup: After his invincible Golden Spear is destroyed, Chrysaor Krishna assumes a meditating position to draw energy from the Kundalini. The point is driven even further when his Chakras manifest as a straight line and Shiryu must destroy them with Excalibur in order to defeat Krishna.

characters.name: Lyumnades Caça
characters.description: Adaptation Personality Change: In the Italian dub, he's called "Lemuri" of Salamander (with Shun pointing out theMeaningful Namenoteafter Lemures, the Roman wraiths). Furthermore, in the original, he's never mentioned to be theLast of His Kind, and the reason why he loses his cool in front of his illusionary copy made byIkkiis because "he can't bring himself to harm someoneas handsome as himself. Animal Battle Aura: A massive salamander manifests when he uses his Salamander Shock. Calling Your Attacks: His attackSalamander Shock. But it is rather weak. Curb-Stomp Battle: Takes out Seiya and Hyoga through foul play, and preys upon Shun's emotional vulnerabilities to eek out a win, but gets dominated in a fight with Ikki. Didn't Think This Through: Had he bothered toscan Ikki's mind thoroughly, he could've found about Esmeralda earlier, therefor using her form to kill him instead of using the form of someone who was lying unconscious next to them as Ikki points out. He could have won the war for Poseidon's side right there!

characters.name: Kraken Isaac
characters.description: An Ice Person: Most of Isaac's attacks are ice based; like Hyoga, he can also project his Cosmo to freeze objects, as shown by his first appearance when he instantly turned the wind into snow. Avenging the Villain: Discussed, then defied. Isaac had great respect for Camus (and the Crystal Saint in the anime), and harbours antipathy towards Hyoga for killing them, but he reflects that in losing to Hyoga they failed to heed their own lessons and thus deserved to die. Berserk Button:People using great power for selfish and/or petty reasons. He was utterly enraged when he found out that Hyoga's primary motivation to become a Saint was to acquire the power he needed in order to visit his dead mother, whose ship-wreck laid at the bottom of the Siberian Sea. Combat Pragmatist: When Kiki claims he only beat Hyoga becauseWorf Had the Flu, Isaac claims he never shows mercy even to women and children. Death Equals Redemption: Reaffirms his friendship with Hyoga in his dying moments and reveals the true significance and identity of the Mariner General Sea Dragon, whom he urges Hyoga to beware in their inevitable battle.

characters.name: Siren Sorrento
characters.description: Action Survivor:He is the only Mariner to survive, and has been accompanying Julian in their journey tohelp the peoplewho were harmed by Poseidon's acts. Beauty Equals Goodness: Figurative version (although he'scertainly pretty enough). Shun hesitates to kill Sorrento because he's convinced that music so beautiful could only be created by a fundamentally noble soul. That might be overstating the case, butSorrentodoespull aHazy–Feel Turnin the arc. Dude Looks Like a Lady: Sorrento can pass for a woman very easily, if not for a fact that he is voiced by a man andlater on is seen wearing a masculine male vest while accompanying Julian. Enemy Mine: When the final Marine General, Sea Dragon Kanon, revealed the plan he started 13 years ago to manipulate Poseidon into starting the war with Athena so that he could take over, Sorrento realized that all of the Generals were onlyUnwitting Pawnsused by Kanon to achieve his goal of world domination. Seeing that it was wrong to awaken Poseidon in this era, he helped Phoenix Ikki destroy the Pillar of the North Atlantic Ocean. Dub Name Change: Known as Syria in the Italian dub. Averted by his techniques, since in the same dub he avertsCalling Your Attacks.

characters.name: Sea Dragon/Gemini Kanon
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: He's blonde in the manga. In the anime adaptation Kanon's hair color was modified to blue - of a darker shade thanSaga. Badass Cape: The only other Mariner who has one, the other is Baian. Batman Gambit: He tries to get his brother to betray the newborn Athena and kill both her and Aiolos. While he does end up convincing him (or, at least his evil half), he also ends up imprisoned. By mere chance he stumbles upon Poseidon's place of imprisonment, and in mere seconds concocts a plan to pit the gods against each other while they're at their weakest, leaving him to plunder the spoils. Big Bad Wannabe: Try as he might, and despite being a crafty bastard that pulled one hell of aBatman Gambit, his plans unravel at the most critical moment and he can't really do anything except watch as everything he has worked years for goes down the drain. Trying to manipulate a god and his loyal generals will do that to you. Ikki and Sorrento consider him so pathetic he'sNot Worth Killing. Cain and Abel:Zigzagged with his twin Saga. In the beginning, Kanon was evil and Saga was good, but Saga went insane for having aSuperpowered Evil Side(comes with being the *Gemini* Saint, of all Gold Saints) and turned evil. Kanon *knew* his brother would become evil and used it to his advantage, staging an epicGambit Roulettethat covers several arcs of the story (two in the manga, three in the anime), where Saga was the firstBig Badand Kanon was theMan Behind the Manfrom both himandhis boss. However, later Kanon pulls aHeel–Face Turnand joins the good guys, while Saga turns evil... apparently.

characters.name: Specters In General
characters.description: Badass Bureaucrat: When they are not currently fighting, the Specter serve in various jobs to help maintain the Underworld. Theme Naming: All of their armors are named after various monsters in mythology

characters.name: The Judges in General
