characters.description: Curtains Match the Window: Notimmediately obviousin Aiacos's case, but he and Rhadamanthys both have eye colours corresponding to their hair. Averted with Minos, who hides golden eyes eerier than Rhadamanthys' for their contrast with his grey hair. Theme Naming: All three of them are named after Greek Kings

characters.name: Wyvern Rhadamanthys
characters.description: Rhadamanthys is the first Judge of Hell shown in the story. A brutal but capable leader, Rhadamanthys is shown to be an overwhelming, intimidating and persistent opponent with a completely no-nonsense attitude. An individual known for not mincing his words, he is unwaveringly bound to his duties. Rhadamanthys is shown to be Pandora's right hand man informally (as he's technically in the same position as the other two Judges). Almighty Janitor: He's the most capable and intelligent element on Hades' army, while not being the most powerful. If something needs to be done, Pandora usually tasks him with it. Ascended Extra: Although he was already a relevant character in the series, Rhadamanthys got this treatment in thePlayStation 2game Saint Seiya: The Hades, where Hades himself wasn't available as a character since the Hades Chapter was not finished yet, so Rhadamanthys (and to a lesser extent Aiacos and Minos) became the playable big bad character, being the final boss who Seiya fights against in the main chapter. Big Ol' Unibrow: Has a single blonde unibrow.

characters.name: Griffon Minos
characters.description: Ascended Extra: Downplayed. In the original series, Minos had the least amount of screen-time out of the three Judges, while here he has an entire volume dedicated to his fight against Albafica. Advancing Boss of Doom: He effortlessly slays all of the Saints and soldiers who appear in his way trying to stop him as he advances towards the Sanctuary. Albafica's poisonous garden halts him, eventually. Ax-Crazy: Minos is a sadist and enjoys torturing his victims by breaking their bones with his signature move. Blow You Away: Gigantic Feathers Flap. A very,verydestructive version. Good Wings, Evil Wings

characters.name: Garuda Aiacos
characters.description: Ascended Extra: Downplayed. He was far from extra-status in the original series, but no one can deny that he is much more developed here. Bad Boss: Two of his moves take the lives of his underlings and use them as human sacrifices to unleash the said attacks. Brought Down to Normal:After his defeat, he is demoted from the Judge title and depowered. Good Wings, Evil Wings Fragile Speedster: Aiacos is fast and strong, but kinda fragile when one manages to land a hit on him.When Sisyphus is finally able to hit him, it'sOne-Hit KO.

characters.name: Pandora
characters.description: Pandora is Hades' right hand in command of his armies, having the Judges of Hell be subservient to her. Like the Specters, Pandora was originally a human being, the child of a wealthy family who unwittingly released the seal containing the gods Hypnos and Thanatos. Being bound to their and Hades' will, Pandora was initially tasked with finding a human host for Hades' spirit as her "brother", a task that made her have a shared past with Ikki and Shun during their childhood as orphans. It's later revealed that her family castle became the Castle of Hades, shown in the beginning of the arc. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Mentioned by Frog Zelos to be as beautiful as she is dangerous. Apocalypse Maiden: As the commander of Hades' armies, Pandora is tasked to wreak havoc on the mortal world and bring destruction upon it. Applied Phlebotinum: Her rosary allows her to travel through Hyperspace and into Elysium. This makes her the only non-deity in Hades' army capable of such a feat.

characters.name: Other specters
characters.description: Cruel and Unusual Death: Hyoga unleashes Aurora Execution. However, he's still alive and tries to move andbreaks his frozen feet off before falling down and shattering. Expy: He looks like theX-Menvillain Toad. Professional Butt-Kisser: Pandora's. Smug Snake: Boasts his lordship of Hades Castle, but his is a five-minute rule: Hyoga obliterates him for brutalizing the powerless Camus. Sycophantic Servant: A grovellingtoady, althoughhe'll sneerat certain of his betters if he can get away with it.

characters.name: Athena
characters.description: The Greek Goddess of defensive warfare, Athena is the greatest defender of the Earth and humanity as a whole. InSaint Seiya, Athena incarnated into a baby under the protectorate of the Sanctuary, though the baby was stormed outside by the Gold Saint Sagittarius Aiolos after an attempt on her life by the Pope. Hunted as a traitor by his fellow Gold Saints and mortally wounded, Aiolos would encounter a tourist in Greece, the magnate Mitsumasa Kido, and would leave the baby Athena and his Gold Cloth to the man's care, stating that the goddess incarnate must be protected at all costs. Kido would raise the girl as his granddaughter Saori Kido, and using the resources of his Graad Foundation, he would gather a group of orphans to be raised as Saints to protect her. Initially cruel and spoiled towards the orphans, Saori, now a 13-year-old socialite and acting head of the Foundation after her grandfather's death, would later summon the orphans who successfully became Bronze Saints in order to provoke the Sanctuary into reaction, thus starting the main plot in the story. Slowly, and through much shared toil, Saori would come to earn the trust of the Bronze Saints in the quest to regain her post as the goddess Athena and lead the Sanctuary to face the impending Holy Wars to come. Athena is shown to dislike putting her Saints at direct peril, and would rather sacrifice herself for their sake. Recognizing her role as protector of humanity, Saori puts herself at the forefront of the conflict at hand and uses her mighty powers to prevent and contain the destruction of the world by other gods, which comes at odds with the fact that she's incarnated as a vulnerable human, necessitating the protection provided by her Saints. Still, often at a mortal peril, Athena actively encourages and empowers her Saints during the Holy Wars to survive and overcome their opponents. Adaptational Heroism: In classical myth, Athena was just as cruel and petty as the other gods of Olympus. Here, she's

characters.name: Poseidon
characters.description: Brought back into a new Holy War against Athena by drowning the world into the oceans, Poseidon raises his Mariners to the battle, the guardians of the Seven Pillars that sustain said oceans. However, it's revealed that his own awakening may not have been entirely due to his own willpower. Adaptation Dye-Job: He's blonde in the manga. The blue hair did help in emphasizing his "Sea God" status, though. Arc Villain: In his own arc. Attack Reflector: As Aiolia once remarked of Athena's Cosmo, Poseidon's Cosmo is vast enough to turn attacks back on their sender. Julian likens the phenomenon to spitting at heaven and finding your face wet. Because Destiny Says So: Julian Solo embraces his destiny as Poseidon's reincarnation.

characters.name: Hades
characters.description: Affably Evil: He's quite restrained and polite most of the time, offering his enemies several chances to leave peacefully and await the coming doom quietly. True to his inspiration, he's also very fond of music and being the creator of a Paradise like Elysium, it's very apparent that Hades can appreciate beauty and art -Just not humans. All Crimes Are Equal: He judges humans for killing animals and plants, even though humans need them in order to feed. While fightingSaori in her God Cloth, he essentially describeslivingas humanity's sin. Arch-Enemy: To Athena. Badass Cape: A deep, dark red, paired with ablackened silver Surplice.The cape gets incinerated in battle with the Bronze Saints. Back from the Dead:He is the one who granted Shion, Aphrodite, Shura, Camus, Deathmask, and Saga twelve hours of life in order to take Athena's head. The fallen Silvers were also granted this in the anime only.

characters.name: Thanatos and Hypnos
characters.description: Being bound to their and Hades' will, Pandora was initially tasked with finding a human host for Hades' spirit as her "brother", a task that made her have a shared past with Ikki and Shun during their childhood as orphans. Adaptational Badass: In Greek Mythology, Thanatos is a minor Godwho Herakles once defeated with his bare handsto bring a grieving friend's wifeBack from the Dead. Here, he easily destroys the Gold Cloths; something that had never happened in all the millennia the Cloths had existed. Berserk Button: Flies into a rage when Seiya draws blood, sharing his master's opinion that mortals raising their fists against gods is sacrilegious. Co-Dragons: With Hypnos, to Hades, being his strongest followers and serving as the last line of defense for his body in Elysium. Creepy Twins: With Hypnos.

characters.name: Cassios
characters.description: A pupil of Shaina and one of the main contenders for the Pegasus Cloth, which he loses to Seiya. He mostly serves as Shaina's right hand man. Adaptational Badass: In the anime version, he is able to defeat both Shiryu and Shun without any trouble, nor any Cloth. Also, he fought Aiolia till the end and even holding him for a while (implying he awakens his Cosmo), going as far asTaking the Bulletfor Seiya, instead of killing himself like in the manga. Anti-Villain: Cassios is no saint, pun intended, but compared to some of the more gruesome villains he's more or less just an angry thug; As shown when he throws his life away for Shaina's sake and saves both Seiya and Aiolia when his strength is put in the right direction. Ax-Crazy: In the manga version, he collected the severed heads of his opponents, and was planning on doing the same thing with Seiya. Badass Normal: Cassios is strong enough to fight Saints if they are not invested fully in the fight, as Shun and Shiryu learn. He wasn't a candidate for the Pegasus armor for nothing.

characters.name: Jaki (Anime Only)
characters.description: Amanojaku: Jaki is a very oni-looking giant of a man who, on orders of the Pope, attacks Eagle Marin. When he fails to squash her by throwing a boulder, they grapple. Just as Jaki is about to crush her to death, Eagle Marin causes both of them to tumble off a cliff. She shows up later, while Jaki seems to have died from the fall. Ax-Crazy: He loves violence. His cruelty is the reason for his failure to become a Saint. The Brute: Has an enormous strength. Also acts as aFoilto Cassios, who shows far more humanity and noble qualities by the time Jaki appears. Disney Villain Death: He dies after falling off a cliff. Everyone Has Standards: On the receiving end: Saints are notoriously ruthlessCombat Pragmatists, with their ranks including the likes ofCancerDeathmask... Butthis guywas rejected.

characters.name: Gigas (Anime Only)
characters.description: Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: When Gigas sees that Ikki has killed the Fire Saint, he and the guards who accompanied him sanctuary run away. Since then, he disappeared and was never seen again. The Dragon: Gigas was at first the personal adviser and chief of staff to the Pope Arles, commanding and directing the missions of the Saints of Sanctuary of Athena. Evil Chancellor: Has a quite high position, and a nasty disposition. Evil Mentor: To Phaeton. Eyepatch of Power: It's actuallya freaking diamond.

characters.name: Ohko (Anime Only)
characters.description: Ohko is a former pupil of Libra Dohko and Shiryu's former sparring partner. He was rejected by Dohko due to his violent ways. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Grew up to become this, after the loss of his parents and the rejection from his former master. Animal Motifs: Tiger. Anti-Villain: He's not really evil, just very violent and seeking rivals to crush and become a stronger fighter. Despite his ways, Ohko still keeps some standards, as he proves it when he rescues Shunrei after she almost drowns in the Rozan waterfalls (Shiryu was unable to save her due to being blind at the time). He challenges Shiryu to a duel to the death, but when he learns Shiryu has become blind, he keeps it fair by blindfolding himself because he truly wants to defeat Shiryu honorably. When he still loses to Shiryu, he admits Shiryu was the stronger fighter after all and as he lays down agonizing from their fight, he asks the Dragon Saint to keep fighting for the sake of those he loves. The Berserker: Dohko's observation of his fighting style.Dohko: I've never seen a man so driven by fury. One might even call him a berserker!

characters.name: Phaeton (Anime Only)
characters.description: The Bus Came Back: Reappears towards the end of the Sanctuary arc to waylay Marin, whose death he hopes will redeem his failures. Shaina pulls aBig Damn Heroeson him and his navigation of the temples is exploited to deliver Marin to Seiya's side. Evil Redhead: Has red hair. Filler Villain: He and Gigas appear only in the anime. Inconsistent Spelling: Also known as Bhaton. No-Nonsense Nemesis: When he's put in charge of recovering the Gold Cloth helmet, hisfirstmove is to send inLizard Misty,a fighter so respectedthat Shaina stopped demandingshewas sent the moment she heard because it was obvious he'd come back triumphant, and thengave him back-upin the form of the almost as formidable Marin and Centaurus Babel and the almost unbeatable duo ofCetus Mosesand Hound Asterion (amind reader), just to stay on the safe side.Deconstructedwhen Marin's betrayal and the arrival of the Steel Saints cause everyone else to die, as the only Silver Saint of comparable power isShainaand he has no authority over the Gold Saints.

characters.name: Esmeralda
characters.description: Abusive Parents: In the anime, she was Master Guilty's daughter. In the manga, she was a mere slave girl sold to Guilty's crew. Beauty Equals Goodness: Very sweet and very cute. Break the Cutie: She was nearing complete breakage when she's first seen, but then... Florence Nightingale Effect: With Ikki. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Holds the distinction ofbeing the only person on Death Queen Islandwho showed Ikki any measure of kindness.

characters.name: Eurydice
characters.description: Eurydice is Orpheus' significant other and a penitent woman embedded in stone in the middle of Hell. Black Eyes of Evil: Averted, she's not a villain at all. Brooding Boy, Gentle Girl: With Orpheus. I Want My Beloved to Be Happy: Felt guilty that Orpheus was always sad and wouldn't leave her side after her death. Star-Crossed Lovers: With Orpheus.

characters.name: Jacob
characters.description: Break the Cutie: Anime-only,when Crystal wentBrainwashed and Crazyand enslaved everyone in the village. Jacob managed to escape and broke down in tears when Hyoga came to help him.He manages to get better, though. Tagalong Kid: For Hyoga whenever he's in Siberia, and for the duration of the Natassia side story.

characters.name: Kiki
characters.description: Bratty Half-Pint: He often tends to mock people. Distressed Dude: To be fair, heismuch younger than the teenaged Saints. Facial Markings: The markings on his forehead, characteristic of his race. Hidden Depths: Despite his penchant for making fun of people, Kiki is tremendously loyal and dutiful, earning him the friendship of the Bronze Saints. Human Shield: Shield's Seika from Thanatos' attacks with his own body.

characters.name: Little Helen (Anime Only)
characters.description: Break the Cutie: Poor little girl has itrough. Surprisingly, she manages to bounce back and get better. Girlish Pigtails: Her hairstyle. Heroic By Stander: Being near Ikki when he's recovering makes her a target of Shiva and Agora. She manages to hold on. Innocent Blue Eyes: Has blue eyes. Plucky Girl: This is the girl who, after helplessly watching her grandfather's murder at the hands of Shiva and Agora and being thrown alive inside a burning volcano, manages to hold on the burning rock walls andclimb her way up, which gives a dying Ikki hisHeroic Resolveback.

characters.name: Miho
characters.description: A childhood friend of Seiya and the caretaker of the orphanage where both her and Seiya grew up. All Love Is Unrequited: Poor girl doesn't even get to tell Seiya her feelings proper before she and the orphanage are unceremoniously chucked out of the narrative. Betty and Veronica: She's the Betty to Saori's Veronica, being Seiya's childhood Friend. Keep in mind, Seiya has only been ship teased with both girls. Dub Name Change: "Lania" in Italian. Girlish Pigtails: Her hairstyle.

characters.name: Mitsumasa Kido
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Considering that the Bronze Saints are his biological kids (manga) or his pupils (anime), theTraining from Hellhe made them go through qualifies as abusive for sure. The Chess Master: He is the head of the Graad Foundation and used it to find his large number of children (or locate and pretty much abduct a just as large number of orphan boys) that, in the future, become the Bonze Saint and Athena's protectors. Dub Name Change: To keep up with Saori Kido becoming "Lady Isabel" and Tokyo itself being "New Luxor", Mitsumasa Kido is renamed "Alman of Thule" in the Italian version of the anime. Kansas City Shuffle: In the manga, he changes the appearance of the Sagittarius Cloth on purpose, to the point that the Silver Saints think it is a fake. Karma Houdini: Sacrifices his own children, gets to die of old age before any of them could make him bleed for it.

characters.name: Natassia
characters.description: Natassia was Cygnus Hyoga's mother who perished after her ship sank in the Arctic Ocean, leaving the ship stranded from the thick icy surface. She is the main reason Hyoga became a Saint. Curse:In theDiCdub. While trying to protect young Hyoga, an evil sorcerer attacked.She was so weakandalas they were too strong.Now she sleeps in the bottom of the ocean awaiting the daythat her beloved son,Hyoga will win the Gold Cloth and use its powertowake her up. Believe it or not, this is the summary that Hyoga gave while using his surfer accent. Human Popsicle: She died when the ship sinks into the icy sea near Siberia. As the ship sunk in the icy sea, her body remained unblemished. Missing Mom: To Hyoga. Having the ability to visit her frozen tomb was the real reason who drove Hyoga to became a Saint. Posthumous Character: Natassia is a recurrent character in Hyoga's memories, and this was used many times by his enemies, to make him remember the grief he felt when he lost his mother. Except theDiCdub (see above).

characters.name: Seika
characters.description: Seika is Pegasus Seiya's elusive older sister, whose disappearance plagues Seiya. Seika was forcibly separated from Seiya once the boy was taken by the Graad Foundation. Break the Cutie: After that her brother Seiya was taken away from her. Cool Big Sis: To Seiya and Miho. Easy Amnesia:She had lost his memory immediately after arriving in Greece, following the footsteps of his brother and falling into a ravine. Identical Stranger: Played with. Throughout the story, it's heavily implied that Eagle Marin may be Seika in disguise due to common physical traits (same age, build, hair shape and color),but it's not until the Hades Arc that it's confirmed that this is not the case, as Marin herself discovers the amnesiac Seika living in a village close to the Sanctuary.

characters.name: Shunrei
characters.description: Shunrei is Dragon Shiryu's childhood friend and love interest, who is also under the care of Libra Dohko. A fellow ward of the Old Master Roshi at Rozan, just like Shiryu, Shunrei is also an orphan. Damsel in Distress: The major example is when Deathmask, annoyed by her prayers for Shiryu, throws the girl in the waterfall trying to kill her. Dub Name Change: "Fior di Luna"(Moon Flower) in Italian. Implied Love Interest: Of Shiryu. They're married in the non-canon workSaint Seiya Omega. Plucky Girl: Has her moments, specially in the anime.

characters.name: Tatsumi Tokumaru
characters.description: Battle Butler: He is apparently good at kendo.Not that it does him any good in a show where superpowered boys are the rule. Butt-Monkey: He always tries to be strong and protect Saori but even the Sanctuary soldiers can defeat him. Is the series' comic relief. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: He's far from a Saint —upper and lowercase— but he's also a third-dan kendo master capable of holding off a squad ofmooksfrom Sanctuary untilThe Cavalryof Bronze Saints relieves him. The Dog Bites Back: Ikki comes back six years after the huge beatdown Tatsumi gave him, and after his fiery entrance he makes a vow before the crowd to make him pay for what he's done.And he fills it right there. Characterization Marches On: He starts as a rather flat and downright abusive retainer for the future Saints, later develops as a man who was honor-bound to protect Saori (while still being rather unpleasant to the saints), and ultimately was the series' comic relief.

characters.name: Saint Seiya: The Movie (Movie 1)
characters.description: Artifact of Doom: Her Golden Apple, which not only lets her possess Eri, but also steal Saori's energy to regain her original body. Big Bad: Of the first movie. Conveniently an Orphan: Eri is an orphan, just like Seiya, his sister Seika, and Miho. Demonic Possession: The goddess Eris took control over Eri's body until she could be completely revived into this world again. Evil Counterpart: Eris to Athena herself.

characters.name: The Heated Battle of the Gods (Movie 2)
characters.description: The Big Guy: He is a physical monster of a man, towering over about everyone. He could be a serious contender for the hardest purely physical foe Seiya and his friends faced. Big Bad: Of second movie. High Priest: Is the Gothi, the representative of Odin on Earth. Meaningful Name: His name is an anagram/reverse of Baldr, who was a revered god of good. This is a hint to his true nature as an evil man. Mind Rape: With a throwaway line where he shows his disbelief at Hyoga breaking free from his "demon fist"noteThe generic name for all Illusion/psychic control attacks wielded by Ikki, Saga or Kanon, he ends up confirming that he has used this on the Cygnus Saint, thus unambiguously explaining his behavior in the movie.

characters.name: Legend of Crimson Youth (Movie 3)
characters.description: Attack Reflector: Like most deities inSaint Seiya, he has the inherent power to reflect (almost) any attack directed against him. A God Am I: Invoked by him at the very end. With the blasphemous implication that he is THE God above all others. Back from the Dead: He resurrected the fallen Gold Saints and bound them to his service and will.Seiya was utterly indignant at this act. Big Bad: Of the third movie. Cain and Abel: The Cain to Saori's Abel. (Dramatic irony definitely intended; see below) He believes mankindis beyond saving, his sister begs to differ, things get murdery.

characters.name: Warriors of the Holy Battle (Movie 4)
characters.description: Ambition Is Evil: His ambition is become the highest among all Gods. Big Bad: Of the fourth movie. Big Bad Duumvirate: With Abel, Eris and Poseidon. Lucifer draws them to himself, gaining their support and cosmos to manifest a physical body on Earth and continue the conquest of the universe, in exchange for their promises dominion over the planet and the life of Athena to resuscitate them. Card-Carrying Villain Fallen Angel: His classic backstory. Lucifer was considered in the Kingdom of Heaven to be the most beautiful and powerful sentient being after the Creator himself. Because of this, he developed pride and lust for domination upon all of creation, and declared war on its Creator. He was subsequently defeated, and then banished from heaven along with his followers.

characters.name: Heaven Chapter~Overture
characters.description: Adaptational Heroism/Adaptational Villainy: Shows up in the Next Dimension manga, not nearly as cold or harsh as in the movie. Big Bad: Of the movie. Canon Immigrant:Canon Discontinuityas this movie may be, she still shows up in the manga. Greek Mythology: Goddess of the moon, hunting, bears, childbirth and chastity among other things. All-Encompassing Mantle: Besides a diadem, all he wears is a massive billowing white cloak completely obscuring any God Robe he may have underneath.

characters.name: Present Bronze Saints
characters.description: Seethe Bronze Saint characters pagefrom classic series.

characters.name: 18th Century Bronze Saints
characters.description: A young orphan who was taken in by Suikyo along with Alone. Although he was selfish as a child, he came to realize the error of his ways and grow up to be a strong, dedicated young man. He's deeply loyal to Alone, who forgave his selfish actions as a child. Suikyo taught him how to burn his cosmo, a skill that would later save his life when he donned the Pegasus cloth in order to free Alone from Hades' possession. Big Bad Friend: His best friend Alone winds up as the vessel for Hades. Bully Hunter: He would always take care of Alone's bullies. Honor Before Reason: Defied! He's one of the few saints who realizes that the new saints from the future came to help, so he ignores many reestablished rules in order to help them. He also is willing to work with the Gold Saints whom just a moment ago were trying to murder his best friend because he understands that they had the best of intentions, and are likely his best bet on getting Alone back to normal. There's also hisKnow When to Fold 'Emmoment below. Homoerotic Subtext: With Alone. His entire talk about the importance of feeling another man's warmth and how thatchanged his ways.

characters.name: 18th Century Gold Saints
characters.description: Doomed by Canon: The original series established that only Dohko and Shion survived the previous Holy War, putting everyone else's odds of survival at zero. TheSaint Seiya Originmanga released duringNext Dimension's run reconfirms this, with Pope Shion directly naming the other ten Gold Saints and noting they all died during the Holy War. Generation Xerox: Many of them share more than a few similarities to their 20th century successors in design, personality, history, and/or abilities. The only ones who don't are Dohko (the one holdover between lineups), Gestalt (although Shijima takes on some of Aiolos' traits), and Odysseus (and even he has some similarities to Sagathanks to Asclepius). A loud giant of a man, Ox bears more than a passing resemblance to his 20th century successor, Aldebaran. His strength is so great that he can fight even while sitting down. Animal Motifs: As the Taurus Saint, he's strongly associated with bulls. Even his name, Ox, is derived from that of the animal. The Big Guy: He's the largest of all the 18th century Saints; so large, in fact, other characters often struggle to reach past his knees.

characters.name: Satellites
characters.description: The Satellites are Artemis's equivalent to Athena's saints. They're warriors dedicated to protecting the moon goddess, almost completely consisting of women archers. Homoerotic Subtext: For Artemis. Number Two: Is this to Artemis. Hoist by His Own Petard:She was about to finish Shun off when Ikki appeared and threw one of her arrows back at her. A former Angel, who was banished from the heavenly realm and imprisoned outside Artemis' temple on Olympus. Callisto tasks him with killing the comatose Seiya, in return for his freedom.

characters.name: Gods and Goddesses
characters.description: After Hades' defeat, Saori takes care of the comatose Seiya. She eventually discovers that Seiya's heart is slowly being penetrated by Hades' sword of grudges, which will kill him in three days. Saori chooses to save the life of the man who did so for her so many times and travel back in time in order to destroy Hades' sword in the previous Holy War. SeeSaint Seiya Gods characters pagefrom classic page for more info. It Amused Me: The only justification given for him turning Athena into a baby is that it was a "prank" for her arrogance. Jerkass Gods: While he does grant Athena's request to send her into the past, he opts to revert her into a baby as a joke, and when pressed for an explanation by Hecate, he simply tells her to go away and let him sleep. Time Master: As the god of time, he can send people to different points in time and space, and can even affect their age to make them older or younger than before.

characters.name: Specters
characters.description: Tenma and Alone's childhood caretaker, a friend of Shion and Dohko, and the former Crateris Silver Saint. He left the Sanctuary after the death of his younger brother due to illness. He saved Alone and Tenma from freezing to death as children, and taught the latter how to use his Cosmo and left him with the Pegasus Cloth, before resurfacing as one of the three Judges of Hell. Died in Your Arms Tonight:He dies in Dohko's arms. Even Evil Has Standards: He isnota fan of Deathtoll'sHeel–Face Revolving Doorpractices. First-Episode Twist: The fact that he defected to the Underworld Army is treated as a plot twist, but happens aboutthree chapters in. I Did What I Had to Do:He defected because the Specters are holding his brother's soul hostage.It turns out to be more complex: he was tasked by Odysseus with taking any action he could to destroy him to prevent Asclepios' return, and he ended up tasking Tenma with this. Also, the Pope gave him a secret mission to fake defecting to Hades and take advantage of the confusion to kill Hades; thus explaining nicely why he, and the Pope seemed to have betrayed Athena. Odysseus realizes he decided to bear this cross, alone, and be viewed as a traitor forever.

characters.name: Others
characters.description: Tenma's childhood friend, and a skilled painter. He's incredibly kind and selfless. He's tricked into taking Hades' sword by Pandora, invoking his possession by Hades. And I Must Scream: It's implied that he's still aware of himself within the darkness of Hades' soul, calling out to Tenma for help. The Pope of Sanctuary during the Holy War of the 18th century. After promoting Shion and Dohko to the rank of Gold Saints, he's revealed to be plotting to assassinate Athena after she travels back in time from 1990. The Faceless: The Pope's helmet covers his face in shadow, and what he looks like underneath it is unknown. Fake Defector: Pandora reveals to the Specters that the Pope is on their side, and is conspiring to have the newly-arrived Athena killed. However, the truth is more complicated.He isn't plotting to kill the current era's Athena, but the Athena from 1990 as he learned years before that her presence would bring untold calamity. Furthermore, he isn't in league with Hades at all, and in fact ordered Suikyo to become aFake Defectorhimself so he could get close to Hades and kill him.

characters.name: Agasha
characters.description: And Your Little Dog, Too!: Minos targets her when he sees her rose and is reminded of the Pisces saint. Break the Cutie: When she watches Albafica die. Daddy's Girl: Is very close to her father. Declaration of Protection: Albafica promises to protect her and her village. He even gives her a rose as a symbol of his promise. Grave-Marking Scene: Still visits Albafica's grave after the six-year time skip in the gaiden.

characters.name: Sui
characters.description: Cynicism Catalyst:His death is this to his older brother, Bennu Kagaho. Identical Stranger: Looks just like Alone. Protectorate: He used to be this for Kagaho. Spear Counterpart: A male version of Esmeralda. Odd since she's a female version of Shun. Too Good for This Sinful Earth

characters.name: Sea Dragon Unity
characters.description: The Atoner:Too bad his atonement stopped after delivering theMacGuffin. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Unity dissapears from the story after hisHeel–Face Turn. Composite Character: Of Kanon when he was Poseidon'sDragon, Hilda from the Asgard saga and Alexei from Hyoga's special chapter. Cynicism Catalyst:Seraphina's death is this to him. Evil Former Friend: Degel's.

characters.name: Seraphina
characters.description: Apocalypse Maiden: Since Unity plans to revive Seraphina involves turning her into aSoul Jarfor Poseidon, her resurrection would cause an unstable Poseidon to flood the world. Came Back Wrong: When revived as Poseidon's unchoosen host. Cynicism Catalyst:Her death is this to her younger brother, Unity Human Popsicle:Degel freezes himself and Seraphina along with the entire city of Atlantis in order to prevent Poseidon's awakening. The Lost Lenore: To both Unity and Degel.

characters.name: Sasha/Athena
characters.description: Action Girl:Once she dons the fabled Athena Cloth. Adorably Precocious Child: She was taken to the Sanctuary at around 8-10 years old and had been maturing herself up for the role of Athena ever since. Barrier Maiden: She surrounded the Sanctuary with a barrier to prevent Hades from resurrecting his Specters within its territory, until Asmita created theMacGuffincapable of sealing the Specters. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Sasha is aFoilto Saori in some ways:While Saori leaned more on her Goddess side the longer the series went, Sasha staunchly leans more on her human side. Also, Sasha is considerably less plagued with doubt than Saori.Their backstories also parallel each other: Saori was born in the Sanctuary, but lived her childhood in a wealthy manor without knowing her divine heritage because the Sagittarius Saint saved her from an assassination attempt by the fake Pope, whereas Sasha was born in a poor orphanage, but was taken to the Sanctuary by a Sagittarius Saint for protection. While Saori leaned more on her Goddess side the longer the series went, Sasha staunchly leans more on her human side. Also, Sasha is considerably less plagued with doubt than Saori.

characters.name: Pope Sage
characters.description: Did You Just Scam Cthulhu?:"I wouldn't be the Pope if I wasn't able to predict the next moves of the gods." Heroic Sacrifice:Gave his life so he could seal Thanatos' soul. My Greatest Failure:Manigoldo, not only dying before him, but doing so in order to give him an opening in defeating Thanatos. Old Master: To Manigoldo. Retired Badass: Before becoming Pope, Sage was the previous Gold Saint of Cancer and one of the few survivors of the previosu holy war.

characters.name: Pegasus Tenma
characters.description: Attack Animal:Youma sees him as this, and intends to harvest his soul to use it as a weapon against Olympus. Back from the Dead: When Alone killed him in the first battle of the Holy War; thanks to Athena's divine protection in the flower garland, his soul was kept alive and subsequently rescued by Yato and Yuzuriha from Yomotsu Hirasaka. Break the Cutie: Not very rare.Learning that the place where he grew up was ravaged by Specters and that his childhood friend is behind it all. Aldebaran's death, while he was unconscious. Dohko's apparent death, and the fact that he blames himself (and Degel doesn't help by agreeing that it's his fault). Yato and Yuzuriha turning into stone. Finding himself face to face with his beloved mother, who came back as a Specter. The Chosen One: According to legends, the Pegasus Saint is always a key character in the Holy Wars against Hades, so everyone seems to think Tenma is some kind ofchosen oneand must make it through the war and face Hades. Tenma initially seems to think this means he'sBlessed with Suck. Determinator: He is a Pegasus Saint after all.

characters.name: Unicorn Yato
characters.description: Break the Cutie: In the Forest of the Dead, when tricked into believing that Tenma and Yuzuriha were killed.Roaring Rampage of Revenge: And this is where we first truly see that he really loves them, as he goes beyond his own limits to "avenge" them. Roaring Rampage of Revenge: And this is where we first truly see that he really loves them, as he goes beyond his own limits to "avenge" them. Brought Down to Normal:At the end. Catchphrase: "The great Yato..." Determinator: Even though he knows his own limitations, he won't give up until the very end.

characters.name: Minor Bronze Saints
characters.description: The Big Guy: Bear Douglas, the biggest Bronze Saint. Dead Person Conversation:To Tenma and Yato. Heroic Sacrifice:To activate the Ship of Hope. The Power of Friendship: Wolf Junkers rants about it quite a few times. The Smart Guy: Hydra Curtis.Sacrificed paving the way throughwild thorns.

characters.name: Crane Yuzuriha
characters.description: Action Girl: Trained in combat from a very early age. Distaff Counterpart: Of Hyoga, in areallyvague way. She has, at least, killed someone close to her, which was practically aRunning Gagfor Hyoga. The personalities are also similar. Also, both wear Cloths based on birds. Facial Markings: It seems to be common for her race, as Sage, Hakurei, Shion andMualso have it. Freaky Fashion, Mild Mind: Her skimpy dressing style contrasts greatly with her calm, mature personality. Huge Girl, Tiny Guy: She is really tall comparing to Tenma and Yato. This also implies that she's quite older than them.

characters.name: Altar Hakurei
characters.description: Blood Knight: Implied in chapter 88, downright confirmed in following chapters. Old Master: To Shion, Yuzuriha, Tokusa and Atla. Survivor Guilt: Being one of the survivors of the previous Holy War. Twin Switch:As he and Sage are twins and he isn't very well-known, preferring to work behind the scenes, he poses as his brother after the latter's death, so the morale of the army won't decay over the loss of its leader.

characters.name: Minor Silver Saints
characters.description: Adaptation Expansion: The anime shows them on the trail of Skeleton Soldiers in Italy, on a mission to locate the Forest Cathedral. Came Back Wrong: Brought back by Hades, they were used as puppets in an attempt to kill Athena. Deadly Disc: Auriga's killer saucers. Epic Flail: Cerberus's weapon is a big flail. Fighting from the Inside: Though they're forced by Hades's power to attack Athena, they're internally struggling against it.

characters.name: Atla
characters.description: Big Damn Heroes:The one responsible for teleporting Yato and Yuzuriha away from the Lost Canvas when it was falling apart from the sky. Composite Character: His role is similar to Kiki's, though he looks suspiciously like Mu. Mass Teleportation: Able to teleport an entire army from the Sanctuary in Greece to the vicinities of the Forest Cathedral in Italy. Psychic Powers: Said to be Hakurei's most skilled disciple in terms of psychokinesis.

characters.name: Aldebaran Disciples
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: Blue hair in the manga, black hair in the anime. Badass Arm-Fold: Once he earns the Taurus cloth. Big Damn Heroes: Saves Celintha and Agasha just in time from a landslide during the Taurus Gaiden. The Big Guy: Has immense physical strength, even before he earns his cloth. Long-Haired Pretty Boy: His hair has grown a lot by the time of the Taurus Gaiden.

characters.name: Aries Shion
characters.description: Barrier Warrior: Because of his Crystal Wall attack, which was powerful enough to prevent Minos most powerful attack from destroying Albafica's village. Big Damn Heroes: Pulls one saving Agasha from Minos. Too bad Shion himself is almost killed by Minos and needs anotherBig Damn Heroesmoment to ensue (see Albafica's entry). Combination Attack: Did anAthena Exclamationwith Sisyphus and Regulus to open the gates to the Lost Canvas. Every Scar Has a Story: Two important scars. One in the back of his neck from when he was almost beheaded by Balron René as a child; another in his arm, inflicted by Hakurei shortly after in order to pour some blood into the dying boy. Facial Markings: Short rounded eyebrows as a half-Lemurian.

characters.name: Taurus Aldebaran/Rasgado
characters.description: Badass Arm-Fold: As usual for Taurus Saints, he likes to fight with his arms crossed. Badass Boast: When confronted by Spectres and told he's outnumbered, lacking the advantage Albafica had and can't win, he crosses him arms and says he will fight them ALL as is. He backs it up (in a single attack and never unfolding his arms)! Big Guy Fatality Syndrome: Averted. Cruel Mercy: Averted; he letsKagaholive, but only because he sees no evil in him. Determinator: He takes the most physical damage of all the Gold Saints without actually dying. The guy's a wall.

characters.name: Gemini Defteros
characters.description: All Love Is Unrequited: Platonic, familial version with his brother Aspros. Initially he worshipped Aspros a lot, and pretty much listened to anything he would say, but stopped listening to him after realizing how much Aspros had been corrupted,and he even ended up killing him. Even so, yes, he did stoplisteningto Aspros, but he never stoppedlovinghis older twin. He was even willing to die to cleanse Aspros' corruption. Hell, even death doesn't stop him from loving Aspros, as seen in the fight between Aspros and Mephistopheles Youma, the Gemini Cloth,infused with his soul, protected Aspros.You might wonder whether Aspros really deserved that sacrifice from Defteros, after all the abuse and insults, and even worse, it was Aspros whokilled Defteros.Even Mephistopheles Youma thinks so too.Mephistopheles Youma:The Gemini Cloth? The younger brother? Impossible!He killed you! Why are you protecting him !? Another Dimension: Used this skill to save Dohko in his way delivering Athena's Cloth. The Atoner: As Asmita points out,his sin lies in not seeing what his brother was going through, though Defteros feels more guilty about killing his own brother in the first place. He then spends the following two years trying to earn the Gemini Cloth to fill his brother's shoes. Because You Were Nice to Me: In their childhood, Defteros was shunned and discriminated against as he was the younger twin, and people apparently thought that younger twins would only bring trouble.Aspros was the only one who was kind to himand did anything to defend Defteros from others' assaults. Brainwashed and Crazy:Under the influence of Aspros' Demon Emperor Fist to kill the current Pope Sage.

characters.name: Gemini Aspros
characters.description: All for Nothing:He would have been the Pope should he had been more patient, as Sisyphus refused the post. He didn't even pass the first test before he attempted to kill the Pope for what he thought was a personal insult towards him. Ambition Is Evil:What Youma corrupted is only his love to Defteros. He goes down the wrong path because he is too ambitious, selfish and arrogant to begin with. Another Dimension: Do you seriously expect a Gemini Saint incapable of using this skill? This is how hedisabled Mephistopheles Youma'sTime Masterpower. The Atoner:As part of his atonement, he battles Hades and then Mephistopheles. Back for the Dead:First revived by Hades, then comes back again after his first fight against Mephistopheles Youma.

characters.name: Cancer Manigoldo
characters.description: Big Damn Heroes: Shows up and saves Tenma, Yato and Yuzuriha when they're completely surrounded by Veronica's horde of zombies. Blood Knight: Indeed he loves fighting, and he looks all giddy when Hades/Alone shows up at the Sanctuary. Dead Person Conversation:To Shion and Tenma. Determinator: Literally continues charging at Thanatos despite repeatedly getting injuries and failing to do beyond a tickle towards the God for most of their battle....Pays off the end because not only did Thantos's armor get thrown off from repeated attacks but his human vessel even got injured and Pope Sage was given just enough time to prepare the seal for the god. Did You Just Punch Out Cthulhu?:Manigoldo punches Thanatos, the God of Death himself, in the face and even menages to seal him with the help of his mentor, Sage.

characters.name: Leo Ilias
characters.description: Back in the Saddle: Agrees on donning the Leo Cloth and fighting as a Saintone last time. Impaled with Extreme Prejudice:By Rhadamanthys's horn. Incurable Cough of Death:The very reason he doesn't go to the sanctuary with Aldebaran is because he has a terminal lung disease. He also stays behind to stall Rhadamanthys. Nature Hero: He is one with nature and he is a strict vegetarian. Posthumous Character: Was murdered by Rhadamanthys before the events of the story.

characters.name: Leo Regulus
characters.description: All Your Powers Combined: Deconstructed. Regulus can copy powers and his trump card is a technique consistingof the signature moves of all the Gold Saints combined, but it has a high price:since his body can't endure the side-effects, leading to his death. Awesomeness by Analysis: Nothing escapes him. Once he sees an attack, he's able to fully understand how it works and proceed to perform itbetterthan its original user. Badass Adorable: One could almost describe him as a Cosmosnerd. Berserk Button:Wyvern Rhadamanthys, his father's murderer. Brainy Brunette: Said and proven to be a battle genius.

characters.name: Virgo Asmita
characters.description: Barrier Warrior: Capable of deflecting attacks with his Hāṃ barrier. Blind Seer: Unlike Shaka, he really is blind.Until his last moments, where he actually can see for the first time. Dead Person Conversation:To Defteros thanks to his blood on Tenma's Pegasus Cloth. Eyes Always Shut:He opens them in his last moments. Face–Heel Turn: Subverted. Makes a threat to, but never actually does.

characters.name: Scorpio Kardia
characters.description: Back from the Dead: In his Gaiden story,he died after defeating Huesda with Katakaio Antares,complete with a smile. But then was immediately revived by Quetzalcotl in Calvera's body by removing the Obsidian Fang from Huesda off his heart. Badass Boast: From his Gaiden story, after he defeated the Jaguars that attacked Calvera's tavern.Hah! What a bunch of weaklings! Won't you stand the real heat of my heart!? Does it hurt? You were shot by the golden scorpion. Consider yourself lucky if you faint before the pain kills you! Badass in Distress: In his Gaiden story, he was in complete mercy in Huesda's handby having his heart grabbed from the inside. Sasha arrived just in time before he lose consicousness. Big Damn Heroes: Shows up to save child Yato from a huge Specter and takes him along to the Sanctuary to train and become a Saint. Blood Knight: Even more so than Manigoldo. He couldn't contain himself that his fingers are twitching and asked Degel to let him fight Rhadamanthys instead, to put himself at ease.My needle... It's bothering me... It doesn't want to calm down. Degel, I know you have a score to settle with himbecause he killed your friend... But I can't contain myself any longer. I have to rip him into pieces to calm down!

characters.name: Sagittarius Sisyphus
characters.description: Angst Coma:Hypnos gets him trapped deep inside the Dream World as soon as he falls into a coma, but he doesn't make any effort to get out.Out of guilt(see entry below). Bodyguard Crush:Strongly implied to be in love with Sasha. Combination Attack: Twice. Once with El Cid and Sasha against the Dream Gods, the other instance with Shion and Regulus. Declaration of Protection: Says this to Athena after snapping out of hisAngst Coma. Determinator:His eyes were blinded, his body was broken, his heart ripped out, his consciousness fading away, but through sheer willpower, his body still moves and is able to perform the Athena Exclamation.

characters.name: Capricorn El Cid
characters.description: Absurdly Sharp Blade: In the form of his arms infused with his cosmos. Combination Attack: With Sisyphus (and Sasha) against the Dream Gods. Cynicism Catalyst: El Cid was never a happy-go-lucky man, but the misfortunes suffered by his close friends — the accident that rendered Felser's arm useless and the death of Mine, after a long struggle against tuberculosis — turned him downright sour. Did You Just Punch Out Cthulhu?:He kills three of the Gods of Dreams, two of them completely on his own. Hoist by His Own Petard: He loses his right hand after his signature attack is reflected towards him.

characters.name: Aquarius Degel
characters.description: An Ice Person: His power, also the reason he made a great partner for Kardia, as he was the only one who could cool down Kardia's fever.His powers require him to be cool-headed, otherwise he wouldn't be able to concentrate his Cosmo to stop atoms. This is made clear whenhe loses itagainst Rhadamanthys and rendered his attacks less effective. Lampshaded by Kardia.Scorpio Kardia:Keep your cool, my dear Degel. Fighting like this is not your style. His powers require him to be cool-headed, otherwise he wouldn't be able to concentrate his Cosmo to stop atoms. This is made clear whenhe loses itagainst Rhadamanthys and rendered his attacks less effective. Lampshaded by Kardia. Always Save the Girl: During his mission in his Gaiden story and the mission he was given in the main story, he ended up needing to save Fluorite and Seraphina.Though the word "save" is not quite right for the latter, ashe chose to stay by her sidein death. Ascend to a Higher Plane of Existence:His last words hinted this before dying together with Seraphina to watch over Unity and Blugrad's future.You have suffered so much... Even after death, you continued looking after your brother even while he was on the wrong path. Lady Seraphina.From now on I will remain by your side to help you with that task. To protect Blugrad and it's future. Badass Bookworm: Described to be the most intellegent Saint in the Sanctuary. Made evidently by having his temple filled with books.

characters.name: Pisces Albafica
characters.description: Accidental Murder: Accidentally killed his mentor, Pisces Lugonis, during the Red Bond ritual. Acquired Poison Immunity: He's specially trained to live alongside the poisonous rose field between Pisces temple and the Pope temple. Big Damn Heroes: When Shion's death at the hands of Minos seemed certain... Albafica resurfaces, covered in blood and ready for more! Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Even after Minos used Cosmic Marionettion on him, made him beating his own face, he's still look handsome as ever. Bloody Murder: His Crimson Thorn technique where he uses his own poisonous blood as weapon.

characters.name: Alone
characters.description: Art Initiates Life:Inversion: Everything he paints willdie. The Atoner:After being defeated by Tenma in the last chapters and getting Hades knocked out of him, he tells Tenma and Sasha that he wishes to atone for what he did while pretending to be Hades. Ambiguously Gay: In chapter 214, Alone said"I killed you, Pegasus, the boy I loved more than anyone else."◊However, it isn't confirmed what kind of love he is speaking. Big Bad:Until Hades'srealawakening, upon Alone's defeat. Death Seeker:He wants to be killed before Hades fully takes over him. He doesn't quite get his wish as Hades becomes separated from him in the end, but he still joins Sasha and Tenma to take down Hades. Not unlike Shun.

characters.name: Thanatos
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is jet-black in the anime. Actually, they were pretty faithful to his only colored image from the manga... too bad his hair color on it was wrong. Curtains Match the Window: Dark eyes and hair. Death Is Cheap: Invoked. He is the god of death, so killing people is just second nature to him. Evil Is Petty:Hypnos and Thanatos wipe out Athena's remaining army in the previous Holy War just because Athena utterly defeated Hades.Hypnos correctly points out thatThanatos would be the bringer of his own downfall for not taking humans seriously. Hypnos and Thanatos wipe out Athena's remaining army in the previous Holy War just because Athena utterly defeated Hades.

characters.name: Hypnos
characters.description: Bad Habits: His usual disguise is that of a priest. Big Bad: Of the Twin Gods Arc (volumes 7 through 11). The Corrupter: Hypnos and Pandora convince Alone thatdeath is salvation, leading to hisFace–Heel Turn.Hypnos was also the one who orchestrated child Pandora'sownFace–Heel Turn. Hypnos was also the one who orchestrated child Pandora'sownFace–Heel Turn. Curtains Match the Window: Golden eyes and hair.

characters.name: The Dream Gods
characters.description: Fusion Dance: With the other Dream Gods. The Leader: Of the Dream Gods. Meaningful Name: Comes fromGreek Mythologyword, Oneiroi. Oneiroi means Dreams and is the combination of the sons of Nyx and were Hypnos's brothersand/or children. Taking You with Me:Upon realizing he would soon be rendered powerless and destroyed by El Cid and Sisyphus'sCombination Attackand Hypnoswould never forgive him for his failure, he makes a last attempt to kill Tenma with aSelf-Destructive Charge. Oneiros just didn't count on El Cid shoving him far enough to render his self-destruction harmless to the others,sacrificing himself in the process. Fusion Dance: With the other Dream Gods.

characters.name: Bennu Kagaho
characters.description: Cynicism Catalyst:Sui's death is this for him. Foreshadowing:He awakens the spirit of the Phoenix with his dying plunge into the sun, making him the reason Ikki became the very first Saint ever to don the Phoenix Cloth for the next Holy War. Good Wings, Evil Wings: Subverted as he has no alignment to speak of. Playing with Fire: Fights mainly with flames. The Power of the Sun: Corona Blast; he forms at least one mini-sun and throws it at the opponent.

characters.name: Cait Sith Cheshire
characters.description: All There in the Manual: The name of his moves and the fact that apparently he officially belongs to Aiacos's division are never stated in-universe, but they'rerevealed by Teshirogion a Blu-ray booklet. Captain Obvious: He basically serves to unwittingly fuel Pandora's doubts by making them surface with his constant questions. Cat Boy: Cats are his motif, and he has sharp nails and fangs and the general attitude to go with it. Commuting on a Bus: Since chapter 48, all he does isveryoccasionally pop up alongside Pandora, doing some menial task for her. Defector from Decadence:He bears witness to the battle against Hades and endears himself to Athena unwillingly. He still serves Pandora even after the Lost Canvas is torn down.

characters.name: Alraune Queen
characters.description: Combat Tentacles: The vines in his Surplice act this way. Gender-Blender Name: Yes, a male named Queen. Mercy Kill:He claims to have killed his partner Gordon so he wouldn't have to live with the humiliation of having been defeated and rendered powerless. The Nose Knows: He's able to smell blood to the point of distinguishing the particular odor of each person's blood.That's how he discovers that Dohko is hiding a vial with Athena's blood, and that the Gold Saint himself was infused with the divine blood. Off with His Head!: His preferred method of killing. He does this to countless soldiers in the Sanctuary and attempts to finish Dohko this way.Also the way he kills Minotaur Gordon.

characters.name: Balrog René
characters.description: Adaptational Badass: He is much stronger than his counterpart from the classic series, which was effortlessly killed by Gemini Kanon. Disproportionate Retribution: Could be summarized as: "You don't know immediately if you wanna come with me, so I'm gonna slash your neck and leave you bleeding to death". Evil Counterpart: He really sees a lot of himself in Shion. It's Personal: He took personal offense at the fact that the person that he handpicked to be with him hesitated to come with him. Silence, You Fool!: Almost his catchphrase. The guy really cherishes silence.

characters.name: Basilisk Sylphid
characters.description: Battle Aura: Manifests as a lethally poisonous wind. Bear Hug: Deconstructed.Dohkokills himwith one. Blow You Away: Especially dangerous since it's a venomous version. Elite Mook: Said to be one of Rhadamanthys's best soldiers, alongside Valentine. Evil Counterpart: To Albafica, according to Dohko.

characters.name: Behemoth Violate
characters.description: Amazonian Beauty: It's hard to see it under all her armor and scars (andmost people don't even see her gender), but yes, she's shown nude once and beneath it all, she is a beautiful yet muscular woman. Blood Knight: She really enjoys a good fight against opponents just as strong as she is, and despises having to deal with lesser warriors. Casting a Shadow: Violate'sSignature Move, Shadow Sew, can paralyze her foes. Charles Atlas Superpower: Arguably all of the human Saints and Specters in the franchise are this, but Behemoth Violate is one of the few that stand out even among her equals. She has enormous physical strength even for a Specter or Saint, matched possibly only by Taurus Rasgado, who is the strongest of the Gold Saints. Covered with Scars: She's completely scarred under her Surplice, because of all the fights she took to become Garuda Aiacos's right hand woman. She's even proud of all her scars because she considers them the marks and proof of the badass warrior she is.

characters.name: Nasu Veronica
characters.description: Creepy Crossdresser: Manigoldo even calls him a "tranny". Kill It with Fire:Manigoldo finishes him this way. Necromancer: Does that as his career, compared to Byaku. Ominous Pipe Organ: Uses one to control his zombies. People Puppets: He manipulates corpses, even decomposing children, with his pipe organ.

characters.name: Sphinx Pharaoh
characters.description: Bullying a Dragon: He taunts (and attempts to attack) Underworld Judge Wyvern Rhadamanthys. Defiant to the End:On the brink of death, he cursed the Gate as a final "screw you" to Athena's Army. Magic Music: His music can rip your heart out of your chest. Signature Move: Balance of Curse.

characters.name: Deadly Beetle Stand
characters.description: Ascended Extra: In the original series, he is dead before we meet him. Signature Move: Stand by Me. We Have Reserves:Dies at the hands of his superior, Garuda Aiacos.

characters.name: Deep Niobe
characters.description: Always Someone Better: Pisces Albafica and Basilisk Sylphid have attacks that outclasses his Deep Fragrance, and both have higher poison immunity than him. Deadly Gas: Deep Fragrance. Walking Wasteland: To some extent, though not as powerful asBasilisk Sylphid.

characters.name: Hanuman Tokusa
characters.description: Cain and Abel: With Yuzuriha. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: He is last seen whenAlonesummons the Star Guardians of the Lost Canvas and sends them to their respective temples. Never again. Scarf of Asskicking:Which he passes on to Yuzuriha.

characters.name: Harpy Valentine
characters.description: The Dragon: To Wyvern Rhadamanthys. Death by Irony: Valentine is killed by Rhadamanthys, to whom he swore loyalty. Humiliation Conga: Valentine is beaten up by his superior (Pandora) and killed by the man he was protecting (Rhadamanthys). Kick the Dog: On the receiving end, by Pandora. Shoot the Dog: On the receiving end. By Rhadamanthys.

characters.name: Mandrake Fyodor
characters.description: Berserk Button: Gets really mad (more than usual) when his helmet is kicked away and his Surplice is damaged. Cold-Blooded Torture: Basically his job. The Paralyzer: One of his attack's effects. Signature Move: Strangle Shrill. Warm-Up Boss: The first Specter to be taken out by Tenma, Yato and Yuzuriha's team work. He's strong, but far from enough.

characters.name: Necromancer Byaku
characters.description: Back from the Dead: Was resurrected by Hades once, but still got annihilated. Non-Indicative Name: Necromancer in name only, he hasnoactual power on corpse manipulation.
